<a id="direct-attack-published-compress-other-family--source-and-a-complete-transition-definition"></a>
#### Source and a complete transition definition

[Szykula 2026, Figure 3 and Conjecture 8](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.24245v1)
describes a 3k+6-state family whose synchronization and specified-state
compression threshold were left conjectural. We inspected the rendered
figure. Its displayed case table omits b(0) and some last-state matching
cases; the diagram supplies them. Our theorem uses the COMPLETE definition
given here. It never interprets an undefined case as a free transition.

Put p=k+2>=3 and n=3p. States are the integers 0,...,3p-1. Define:

* a(0)=0. For 1<=i<=2p-1, a(i)=i+1 if i is odd and i-1 if i is even.
  Also a(2p)=2p+1 and a(2p+1)=3. On 2p+2,...,3p-1, a swaps successive
  pairs starting at the EVEN index 2p+2; a leftover last point is fixed.
* For 0<=i<=2p-1, b(i)=i+1 if i is even and i-1 if i is odd.
  Also b(2p)=2. On 2p+1,...,3p-1, b swaps successive pairs starting at
  the ODD index 2p+1; a leftover last point is fixed.

This includes b(0)=1. At the final state, a fixes it when it is even
and otherwise swaps it with its predecessor; b fixes it when it is odd
and otherwise swaps it with its predecessor. Both letters have rank n-1.
All products below use right actions and count every original a/b letter.

<a id="direct-attack-published-compress-other-family--two-actual-cyclic-cores-and-their-entering-words"></a>
#### Two actual cyclic cores and their entering words

Let c=ba and u=ab. Direct substitution gives a c-cycle R, in this order:

    R=(0,2,4,...,2p-2,2p,1),       r=|R|=p+2.

The remaining main-line odd states 3,5,...,2p-1 move down by two under c
and enter at 1. The outer states 2p+1,...,3p-1 form a single directed
chain under c: visit their odd indices upwards, reflect at the last
state, visit their even indices downwards, then go to 3 and 1.
There are p-1 outer states, so the largest c-distance into R is p.
Since c permutes R, we have the EXACT image equality

    Q c^p = R.                                             (1)

Likewise u has cycle

    U=(0,1,3,5,...,2p-1,2),       |U|=p+2.

The other main-line evens move down by two into 2. The directed u-chain
from 2p visits the outer EVEN indices upwards, reflects at the last
state, visits their ODD indices downwards, and enters at 2. It consists
of 2p plus the p-1 outer states, so its distance into U is p. Thus

    Q u^p = U,       U a = R.                              (2)

These are literal words of lengths 2p and 2p+1, not free cycle powers.
The base state graph is strongly connected: the alternating matching
edges connect the whole main line, a reaches 2p and the outer path,
and the exceptional a/b edges return to states 3/2. No group inverse
or external circular-automaton theorem is required.

<a id="direct-attack-published-compress-other-family--an-actual-rooted-return-word"></a>
#### An actual rooted return word

Label R by c-position, with positions 0,...,p+1. Thus position 0 is
state 0, positions 1,...,p-1 are states 2,4,...,2p-2, position p is
state 2p, and position p+1 is state 1. Let d=u^p a, length 2p+1.
In these coordinates its restriction to R is

    d(i)=p-i       for 0<=i<=p-1,
    d(p)=d(p+1)=p+1.                                      (3)

To check (3), state 2i for 1<=i<=p-1 reaches 2 after i-1 applications
of u, then traverses the U-cycle for the remaining p-i+1 applications;
the final a gives position p-i. The cases 0,2p,1 follow immediately
from the listed U-cycle and its outer entering chain.

Both d and c map R into R. Their actual composite v=d c d, of length
4p+4, has the particularly simple row

    v(0)=v(1)=p+1,
    v(i)=i-1       for 2<=i<=p-1,
    v(p)=v(p+1)=p.                                        (4)

This has exactly one directed cycle, the fixed point p. Every position
reaches it within p iterations, with position p-1 attaining p. Therefore

    R v^p={p},
    W=c^p v^p=(ba)^p [ (ab)^p a (ba) (ab)^p a ]^p          (5)

resets ALL Q to original state 2p. Its ORIGINAL length is

    |W|=2p+p(4p+4)=4p^2+6p
       =4k^2+22k+28=4n^2/9+2n.                           (6)

For p>=3, its square slack is

    (3p-1)^2-|W|=5p^2-12p+1
                    =5(p-3)^2+18(p-3)+10 > 0.             (7)

Thus this explicitly defined published family synchronizes for EVERY
k>=1 and has a charged reset witness strictly below Cerny's square.
This is a special-family proof, not a general n-state reset bound.
It settles the synchronization part of the diagram-completed family;
it does not by itself settle the numerical lower-threshold assertion.

<a id="direct-attack-published-compress-other-family--the-specified-state-word-and-the-remaining-lower-bound"></a>
#### The specified-state word and the remaining lower bound

The shorter actual word

    z=c^p u^p=(ba)^p(ab)^p,       |z|=4p=4n/3,              (8)

merges states 0 and 2: c^p sends them to 2p and 1, and u^p sends both
to 2. Hence the compress-with-another threshold of state 0 is AT MOST
4n/3 for all parameters. At the initial checkpoint the matching LOWER bound was OPEN. It is
now PROVED (paper) in [Exact specified-state compression in the completed Figure 3 family](#direct-attack-compress-other-exact-lower), independently of
the older finite pair BFS.

The source displays `(ab)^p a (ab)^p` beside a length 4n/3 claim.
That displayed word literally has 4p+1 letters. It does merge state 0
with state 1, but cannot itself be a shortest word of length 4p.
Equation (8) supplies the correctly charged upper-bound witness with
a different initial partner. This is an arithmetic/word clarification,
not a refutation of the numerical threshold conjecture.

<a id="direct-attack-published-compress-other-family--general-mechanism-and-limits"></a>
#### General mechanism and limits

The reusable statement is elementary: for r>=4, if actual words c,d
preserve an actual image R and act as the cycle and row (3), then d c d is a rooted
transformation of height r-2. An entering word of length E gives

    rt <= E+(r-2)(2|d|+|c|).                               (9)

All entering, reflection and rotation costs are paid. No arbitrary
image is presumed to have such a return structure. In particular, the
earlier arbitrary-image return-synchronization obstruction is unaffected.
Producing an analogous inexpensive rooted word for GENERAL automata is
still missing; membership in their transformation semigroup does not
bound its original word cost or its root height.

This extends to every phase of a reflected adjacent unit. On positions
0,...,r-1 put c(i)=i+1 mod r, h_t(i)=t-i mod r, and let e map 0 to r-1
while fixing the other positions. Suppose d=h_t e is an ACTUAL return
word. If t>=1, direct composition gives

    d c d = (h_t e h_t) c^(-1) e,
    (h_t e h_t): t -> t+1 mod r, all other points fixed.

This equality is used only to compute the row of the ACTUAL word d c d;
it never gives an inverse or the abstract h_t at zero word cost.
The row fixes t. All other points move down by one, with 1 jumping to
r-1. Its root height is r-1 for t=1 and r-2 for 2<=t<=r-1.
For t=0 that word has a nontrivial cycle, so it must NOT be called
rooted. Instead use the actual word d'=c d, whose reflected phase is
r-1. The word d' c d' is then rooted of height r-2, with charged length
2|d|+3|c|. Thus the entering-word reset budgets are, respectively,

    E+(r-1)(2|d|+|c|)         for t=1,
    E+(r-2)(2|d|+|c|)         for 2<=t<=r-1,
    E+(r-2)(2|d|+3|c|)        for t=0.                    (10)

The public family uses t=r-2, giving (6). These conditional budgets
apply to arbitrary actual images with this specified return structure;
a congruence hypothesis is not needed. They do not assert that a general
synchronizing automaton admits such short words. Separate finite tests
include EVERY offset at r=4,...,200, including the bad-phase repair.

Generation and separate verification are in compress_other_family.py
and check_compress_other_family.py. Their scopes and retained literal
words are recorded in data/compress_other_family*.json. They do not
claim an exact whole-Q reset threshold.

Finite scopes: 69 explicit family cases, k=1,...,64 and
{100,128,256,512,1024}; 67 complete pair audits total 859431 vertices.
All 69 entering/reflection/rooted word rows, SC claims, and charged
lengths are separately recomputed. The whole expanded reset words for
k=1,...,12 charge 4652 original letters and are applied to all states.
Six deliberately corrupted certificates are rejected. For k=512/1024
the macro rows and rooted heights are checked; no full pair-distance
enumeration is claimed there. Finite q0 equality holds in the 67 pair
scopes; its arbitrary-parameter LOWER bound is now supplied by the separate
[Exact specified-state compression in the completed Figure 3 family](#direct-attack-compress-other-exact-lower) continuation proof.

## 3　低余维上界与有限归约

集中低余维论证；使用有限计算的地方仍需正文中的完备归约。

- [Uniform codimension-three compression bound](#problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof)

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof"></a>
<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof--uniform-codimension-three-compression-bound"></a>
### Uniform codimension-three compression bound

**Theorem.** In every strongly connected synchronizing complete automaton
with n>=6 states, every (n-3)-subset admits a compressing word of length
at most nine. The alphabet is any finite alphabet; the subset need not
be a reachable image.

The upper bound now has a paper proof: the symbolic classifications below
combine with [trajectory-rank and image-family arguments](#problem4-paper-dependency-reductions).
The former finite action projections are retained as independent controls,
not required proof steps. The n>=6 hypothesis remains essential for pure compression.

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof--reduction-to-nine-ordered-early-pair-types"></a>
#### Reduction to nine ordered early-pair types

The Frankl--Pin compression bound gives ten. Suppose some (n-3)-set
has shortest compression length ten. For h>=1 let P_h contain every
unordered distinct-state pair merging within h original letters.
The refinement of Kisielewicz, Kowalski and Szykuła, CIAA 2016 Theorem 1,
gives compression length at most 10-p(P_h)+h, where p is the longest
(n-3)-subset Frankl--Pin sequence over P_h.

Any q<=4 distinct pairs admit a sequence of length q. Index them
E_0,...,E_(q-1). Choose three holes for its ith subset outside E_i,
hitting an endpoint outside E_i of each later pair E_j, j>i. There
are at most q-i-1<=3 required endpoints, and n-2>=3 available states.
Fill to three holes. Thus E_i is in its own subset and is absent from
every earlier subset, exactly the standard Frankl--Pin convention.
Consequently |P_h|<=h for h=1,2,3. A nonempty synchronizing alphabet
has P1 nonempty. The recurrence adding all letter-preimages of P_h
grows strictly until every pair is present: a plateau is a fixed point
and would contradict synchronization. Since n>=6, it cannot exhaust
all pairs by depth three. Hence |P_h|=h for h=1,2,3.

Write P_h={E1,...,Eh}, E1=01. Each letter is a permutation or has rank
n-1 and common kernel 01. Every two-point inverse image of E1 belongs
to {E1,E2}; every such inverse image of E2 belongs to {E1,E2,E3}.
[Necessary early-pair types for tight compression](#problem4-early-pair-types) proves that the following nine types exhaust all
ordered triples up to simultaneous state relabeling.

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof--common-image-and-exit-argument"></a>
#### Common image and exit argument

Let H be the three-hole covers of P3. Every image of the initial subset
reached by depth six is uncompressed and has holes in H, or a P3 word
of at most three letters would give compression by depth nine. Let
R_i be the distinct images reached by depth i. These grow strictly
until compression: a plateau is invariant under all letters and cannot
be reset. Thus |R_i|>=i+1 through depth nine.

A domain D defined by H-preservation under test words of length at
most L contains R_(6-L). The original classifications identify the domains
listed in the table below. Low-rank domains contradict trajectory growth;
five-cycle and four-row domains prohibit an entrance from their common
outside set; the closed-T domain has displayed actual exit words.
The remaining symbolic counts and invariant-family arguments are unchanged.
All word-length budgets and the special n=5 boundary are proved in
[the replacement lemmas](#problem4-paper-dependency-reductions).
The old action-profile and distance-vector calculations in the detailed
case sections are now independent controls rather than proof dependencies.

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof--complete-case-table"></a>
#### Complete case table

The cited case notes supply the symbolic letter classifications and test domains.
The following paper arguments replace every formerly enumerated action/distance
step; their full details and row families are in
[the paper replacements](#problem4-paper-dependency-reductions).

| type | E2 | E3 | paper exclusion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 02 | 12 | Original Case A/B1 counts; four-row common-entry argument for B2; rank at most four for Case C. |
| 1 | 02 | 03 | Original no-incoming-edge argument at state 0. |
| 2 | 02 | 13 | Five-cycle common-entry argument; original singular-domain counts and two immediate exits. |
| 3 | 02 | 23 | Five-cycle common-entry argument; literal T,TT,ff,f exits from the closed-T domain; original no-T counts. |
| 4 | 02 | 34 | Both six-row domains have rank at most four. In fact this type forces compression by eight. |
| 5 | 23 | 02 | Original inverse-pair disjointness / additional forbidden pair argument. |
| 6 | 23 | 04 | Five-cycle common-entry argument for closed II; original orientation-I and mixing-II counts. |
| 7 | 23 | 24 | All six-row domains and C_A,C_V,D_w have rank at most four; C_T is a five-cycle domain. Original breaker counts complete the reduction. |
| 8 | 23 | 45 | The matching family has rank at most four and contains no reset row in its span. Compression is at most seven. |

All cases contradict compression length ten. This proves the theorem.
Binary complete covers at n=11,12,13 are independent historical checks,
not a necessary step of this uniform upper proof.

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-upper-proof--exact-reachable-image-consequence-and-its-limits"></a>
#### Exact reachable-image consequence and its limits

For n>=10 and 1<=r<=n-5, [A uniform lower bound at codimension three](#problem4-codimension-three-proof) provides binary,
strongly connected, synchronizing witnesses with a reachable (n-3)-image
and local value min(n-r,9). For r=n-4 the first-face theorem provides
the same equality. For 5<=n<=9 every parameter is covered by a literal
binary witness in formula_certificates.json, independently checked by
ordinary subset BFS and original-letter reaching/reset/attaining words.
Since n-r<=8 there, its value U equals min(n-r,9).

Therefore for every n>=5 and 1<=r<n-3,

    F_bin(n,n-3,r) = F(n,n-3,r) = min(n-r,9).

For every n>=11 and 1<=r<=n-10 the conjectured value U is ten, whereas
both maxima are nine. This refutes the proposed formula under the full
binary requirements and for arbitrary finite alphabets. It gives a
partial answer to Open Problem 4; parameters with n-s>=4 are not all
determined. No alphabet separation, priority guarantee or all-parameter
replacement formula follows from this proof.

The hypothesis n>=6 in the compression theorem is necessary for the
five-state-invariant-set arguments. A reachable pair in the strongly
connected synchronizing five-state example in [Path early-type-3 exclusion at codimension three](#problem4-path3-early-exclusion)
has shortest compression ten. Its avoid-or-compress value is bounded
by n-r<=4, so it does not contradict the exact local maximum above.

<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof"></a>
<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof--the-binary-sharpness-requirement-at-1181"></a>
### The binary sharpness requirement at (11,8,1)

This note distinguishes the manuscript's unrestricted-alphabet F from its binary restriction F_bin. The result below concerns F_bin only. It cannot alone refute the unrestricted F formula or solve Open Problem 4 completely.

Two independently implemented completed decision covers give F_bin(11,8,1)=9, whereas the proposed minimum is 10. The lower bound has the following elementary proof.

<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof--an-explicit-lower-bound-9"></a>
#### An explicit lower bound 9

Let T={x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4,z} and K={v,y,c,t}, and add d. Letter b cycles T in the displayed order, cycles v,y,c,t, and fixes d. Letter a interchanges z,y and c,d, sends t to z, and fixes the other states. Its only non-singleton fiber is {y,t}, mapping to z. Put S=T union {v,t}, A={x_3}.

The b-cycles together with the two a-interchanges prove strong connectivity. Direct application of the letters gives Q(abbbabaabb)=S. For completeness, the successive holes along this reaching word are

```
{t}, {v}, {y}, {c}, {t,d}, {v,d}, {v,t,c}, {v,t,d}, {v,y,d}, {y,c,d}.
```

The last hole set is the complement of S.

Here is the complete short-image table. A row records the three holes of an eight-state image. The two successors are valid eight-state images for every row with level less than eight. No successor is needed from a level-eight row.

| Row | Holes | Level | a | b |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| 0 | y,c,d | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| 1 | t,c,d | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| 2 | v,t,d | 2 | 3 | 4 |
| 3 | v,t,c | 3 | 2 | 5 |
| 4 | v,y,d | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| 5 | v,y,t | 4 | 6 | 7 |
| 6 | z,v,t | 5 | 5 | 8 |
| 7 | v,y,c | 5 | 2 | 9 |
| 8 | x_0,v,y | 6 | 10 | 11 |
| 9 | y,t,c | 6 | 12 | 3 |
| 10 | x_0,v,t | 7 | 10 | 13 |
| 11 | x_1,y,c | 7 | 14 | 15 |
| 12 | z,t,d | 7 | 9 | 16 |
| 13 | x_1,v,y | 8 | - | - |
| 14 | x_1,t,d | 8 | - | - |
| 15 | x_2,t,c | 8 | - | - |
| 16 | x_0,v,d | 8 | - | - |

Every listed successor has level at most one more than its source. Induction therefore shows that every word of length at most eight stays in this table; a level-eight row cannot occur earlier. None of the hole sets contains x_3. Thus every word shorter than nine is safe. The word ababbbab reaches row 16, whose image contains both y and t, so ababbbaba compresses at length nine. Equivalently abababbbb omits x_3 at length nine.

To prove synchronization, note that e=a^2 is the global unit t -> y, and b^12 is the identity. Its conjugates b^(12-i)e b^i, for i=0,1,2,3, merge every opposite pair of K. Any pair {d,q} with q in K can be rotated to {d,v}; applying a gives {c,v}, an opposite pair. Thus all d--K pairs merge. The pair {c,z} maps under a to {d,y} and merges. The pair {d,z} maps under b^4 a b^8 to {c,z}, since z b^4=x_3, a fixes x_3, and c b^8=c. Consequently every d--T pair merges after rotating its T-point to z.

Adjacent pairs in K can be rotated to {c,t}; a sends this to {d,z}. For a T--K pair, rotate the K-point to c; if the T-point is z use the preceding {c,z} case, and otherwise apply a to obtain a d--T pair. Finally a T--T pair can be rotated until one point is z, then a sends it to a T--K pair. Every pair merges. Successively merging two points of an image gives a reset of Q, proving synchronization. All conjugates and rotations are words in the original binary alphabet.

The JSON witness supplies the two transition rows, actual reaching word, attaining word and literal reset word. `check_binary_obstruction.py` recomputes exact ac by ordinary subset BFS and checks the table and every stated structural condition.

<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof--reduction-of-the-upper-bound-decision-to-one-kernel-pair"></a>
#### Reduction of the upper-bound decision to one kernel pair

We use the Frankl--Pin set-pair bound: an s-subset Frankl--Pin sequence on n states has length at most T=binom(n-s+2,2). A sequence consists of s-sets S_i and pairs E_i subset S_i with E_i not contained in S_j for any j<i.

Here is the compression refinement from Kisielewicz, Kowalski and Szykuła, *Experiments with Synchronizing Automata*, CIAA 2016, Theorem 1, with the needed argument. Let P be a set of pairs each merging within h letters, and let p be the maximum length of such a sequence over P. If a shortest compressing word for S has length L>h, take its first L-h prefix images. For each choose a pair merged by the corresponding suffix of that word. The pair chosen at a later prefix is absent from every earlier image, since otherwise a shorter compressing word would result. No pair of P occurs in these prefix images either, since appending its h-letter merge would shorten the word. Appending a length-p sequence over P gives L-h+p<=T, hence L<=T-p+h.

If two distinct pairs merge under letters, take those two pairs as P, h=1. Since 2<=s<n they admit a sequence of length two: choose the first s-set to contain the first pair but omit an endpoint of the second not in the first; choose the second s-set to contain the second pair. Thus L<=T-1=9 when n=11,s=8. Every s-subset is compressible in a synchronizing automaton. Therefore compression length ten is possible only when the union of all letter kernel pairs is a single pair K. After exchanging letters, a is singular of rank n-1; b is either a permutation or a rank-(n-1) transformation with the same K.

<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof--completeness-of-the-finite-cover"></a>
#### Completeness of the finite cover

A rank-(n-1) transformation has one state of indegree zero, one of indegree two, and every other state of indegree one. Its functional graph is one transient path of length h>=1 entering a cycle of length L>=1, together with disjoint permutation cycles. Indeed a branching tree before the cycle would have at least two leaves. Up to conjugacy, the first component is

```
0 -> 1 -> ... -> h+L-1 -> h,
K={h-1,h+L-1}.
```

The remaining cycle lengths are an integer partition of n-h-L. If h>=4, a^4 has rank n-4=7 and compresses every eight-state subset. Hence only h=1,2,3 are needed. Enumerating all L and partitions gives 209 first-letter forms for n=11.

For a fixed first form, begin with its path-and-cycle component discovered, in its forced a-order. Assign b-successors to discovered sources successively. A successor in an already discovered component is fully labelled. When a successor first enters an undiscovered a-cycle, its rotation can be chosen to make that successor the cycle's first vertex; equal-length undiscovered cycles can be exchanged to select the first unused one. Append that entire cycle in a-order. This normalization uses only automorphisms of a and fixes all previously discovered vertices. Strong connectivity guarantees that every a-component is eventually discovered. Thus the branching procedure covers every strongly connected b, up to conjugacy preserving a.

Permutation b-successors are injective. In the singular case only the two K-sources share a successor; the second is forced to have the first's value. All other successor choices are injective. The K-sources both lie in the initially discovered component, and the first precedes the second. These alternatives exhaust every admissible b.

For a partial b-assignment let G be the graph of pairs that merge in at most nine letters using only the determined transitions. Reverse pair closure computes these edges exactly for the partial transition relation. Completing b can only add such edges. An eight-state subset avoiding compression through length nine would be an independent set of G; its three-point complement would cover every edge. A partial branch may therefore be discarded whenever G has no vertex cover of size at most three.

The first program checks this by a greedy four-edge disjoint matching when available, followed by a complete depth-three vertex-cover recursion. The independent implementation instead enumerates all 165 three-point hole sets and intersects their edge-cover masks, using bitset pair closure instead of inverse-state-fiber BFS. Their graph connectivity tests also differ. At complete branches, strong connectivity and synchronization are tested exactly; actual full-set images are checked if a compression-delayed subset survives. In the n=11 run no complete branch is both strongly connected, synchronizing and compatible with a three-point cover of the short-pair graph. Thus no binary strongly connected synchronizing eleven-state automaton has an eight-state subset of compression length ten. The conclusion holds even without requiring that subset to be a reachable image.

<a id="problem4-binary-obstruction-proof--audit-checklist-and-results"></a>
#### Audit checklist and results

* The first n=11 cover completed: 209 first-letter forms, 1,415,723,476 successor assignments, 611,559,458 partial prunes and 129,412,072 complete maps; no eligible strongly connected synchronizing map.
* The second n=11 cover also completed. Every assignment, prune and leaf count agrees: 1,415,723,476; 611,559,458; 129,412,072. No eligible strongly connected synchronizing map survives. Its completed n=6,7,8,9 controls also agree with the first implementation in every count.
* The n=5 positive control finds the known compression length ten for a reachable pair. Its ac for a singleton A is smaller; it is not a counterexample to the avoid-or-compress formula.
* `audit_compression_cover.py` independently enumerates labelled first transformations and explicit conjugacy orbits, and repeats all admissible labelled second transformations for n=5,6. Ordinary forward pair BFS agrees with the earlier unpruned C++ cover. This independently checks the first-letter classification and the negative n=6 control.
* Solver timeouts are not used anywhere in this proof. No all-parameter negative statement is inferred from the cover at n=11.

The proposed unrestricted F formula remains a separate question. What this finite obstruction rules out is the requested assertion that its upper bound always has a binary attaining witness.

<a id="problem4-codimension-three-proof"></a>
<a id="problem4-codimension-three-proof--a-uniform-lower-bound-at-codimension-three"></a>
### A uniform lower bound at codimension three

For n>=10 and 1<=r<=n-5, there is a binary strongly connected synchronizing
automaton with reachable S of size n-3 and ac(S,A)=min(n-r,9).
Together with the first face (r=n-4), this proves

    F_bin(n,n-3,r) >= min(n-r,9).

When n-r<=9 the known upper bound agrees, so F_bin=F=n-r.
This does not prove an upper bound nine in the remaining compression range.

Put L=n-5>=5. Let T={x_0,...,x_(L-2),z}, K={v,y,c,t}, and add d.
Letter b cycles T, cycles v,y,c,t, and fixes d.
Letter a swaps z,y and c,d, sends t to z, and fixes the other states.
Set S=T union {v,t}. The same reaching word abbbabaabb works for every L:
its holes are successively
{t}, {v}, {y}, {c}, {t,d}, {v,d}, {v,t,c}, {v,t,d}, {v,y,d}, {y,c,d}.
The a-interchanges join the b-cycles and d, proving strong connectivity.

The complete 17-row short-image table in [The binary sharpness requirement at (11,8,1)](#problem4-binary-obstruction-proof)
is unchanged for every L>=5: it only uses z,x_0,x_1,x_2 from T.
It proves preservation of cardinality through length eight, and that the
first possible missing T-states are z at depth five, x_0 at six,
x_1 at seven, x_2 at eight. No other T-state is absent through depth eight.
The words ababa b^j, j=0,1,2,3, attain those four avoidance depths.
The word ababbbaba compresses at length nine.

For r<L choose the last r of x_0,...,x_(L-2); for r=L choose all of T.
If r<=L-4, all chosen states have index at least three and ac=9.
If r=L-3,L-2,L-1,L, the respective first omitted protected state is
x_2,x_1,x_0,z, giving ac=8,7,6,5. These values equal min(n-r,9).

Here is a synchronization proof valid for every L>=5, including all residues
modulo four. Put N=lcm(L,4), so b^N is the identity. The unit e=a^2 sends
t to y. Conjugates b^(N-i)e b^i merge all opposite pairs in K.
Rotate a d--K pair to {d,v}; a takes it to the opposite pair {c,v}.
The pair {c,z} maps by a to {d,y}. The word b^4 a b^(N-4) takes {d,z}
to {c,z}: z b^4=x_3 (which exists since L>=5), while the final exponent
fixes c and returns the T-point to z. Therefore every d--T pair merges.
An adjacent K-pair rotates to {c,t} and a takes it to {d,z}.
For a T--K pair, rotate its K-point to c; if its T-point is z use {c,z},
otherwise a takes it to a d--T pair. Finally rotate one point of a
T--T pair to z and apply a, giving a T--K pair.
Every pair merges. Iteratively merging two points of the current full-set
image gives an original-letter reset.

No inverse letters are introduced: every conjugate uses nonnegative powers
of b. The bound is a uniform lower construction and becomes an exact value
only where it meets an independently known upper bound. In particular it
does not assert that F_bin or F is nine for all n-r>=10.

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling"></a>
<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--short-pair-peeling-and-a-verified-k4-exclusion"></a>
### Short-pair peeling and a verified K4 exclusion

10 October 2026. New collaborative continuation of upstream
`d57a2077e19932ff69bea9307b69110678e213de`, prepared with Codex assistance.
Priority remains OPEN. All words act on the right and every length counts
original letters. Arbitrary finite alphabets are allowed. Initial subsets
need not be reachable images.

The paper results below do **not** determine either extremum at (13,9,1).
They replace a missing argument behind higher-layer edge caps, rather than
retroactively validating the retracted searches in
`SHORT_PAIR_SPAN`.
Old failed searches still need independent coverage audits.

Let c(S) be the minimum length of a word compressing S. Let P_h be the
simple graph of pairs mergeable in at most h letters. Immediate collisions
are retained in the recurrence; for each letter f, distinct inputs with
distinct images forming an edge of P_h belong to P_(h+1).

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--1-graph-peeling-theorem"></a>
#### 1. Graph peeling theorem

**P4-PEELING — PROVED ON PAPER.** Let G be a simple graph on n vertices,
m>=1, n-m>=2, with maximum degree at most m and vertex cover number at
most m. If |E(G)|<3m, all its edges occur in an (n-m)-subset Frankl–Pin
sequence. Consequently, for arbitrary |E(G)|,

    p_(n-m)(G) >= min(|E(G)|, 3m-1).

Here a sequence (M_i,e_i) has |M_i|=n-m, e_i contained in M_i, and e_j
not contained in M_i whenever i<j. Pairs are distinct. This is the ordering
convention of Kisielewicz–Kowalski–Szykula, *Experiments with Synchronizing
Automata*, CIAA 2016, Theorem 1 and its preceding definition:
[primary PDF](https://jakubkowalski.tech/Publications/Kisielewicz2016ExperimentsWith.pdf).

Proof. It suffices to find an (n-m)-set inducing exactly one edge of each
nonempty remaining graph, then delete that edge and repeat. Deleting edges
preserves both degree and cover bounds.

Take a minimum vertex cover C of size t<=m and put I=V\C. Every c in C
has a neighbor in I: otherwise C\{c} would cover the graph. If some c has

    d_I(c) <= m-t+2,

retain one neighbor v in I, delete the other d_I(c)-1 neighbors from I,
and add c. The resulting set induces precisely cv and has cardinality
n-t-d_I(c)+2 >= n-m. Trim it to n-m vertices while retaining c,v.

Otherwise every c has d_I(c)>=m-t+3. For t<=2 this contradicts the
maximum-degree bound. For 3<=t<=m it gives

    |E(G)| >= t(m-t+3) >= 3m,

because t(m-t+3)-3m=(t-3)(m-t)>=0. This contradicts the edge hypothesis.
Induction constructs the sequence. Applying the result to any subgraph
with min(|E(G)|,3m-1) edges proves the final assertion.

The threshold is sharp as a graph statement for every m>=3. Take K_(3,m)
and any number of isolated vertices. It has degree bound m, cover number
3, and 3m edges. A set inducing exactly one edge contains precisely one
vertex from each side, hence has size at most n-(m+3)+2=n-m-1. Therefore
a sequence containing all 3m edges cannot start. Every one-edge deletion
admits a sequence of length 3m-1 by the theorem, so p_(n-m)=3m-1.

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--2-uniform-short-pair-edge-cap"></a>
#### 2. Uniform short-pair edge cap

**P4-PAIR-CAPS — PROVED ON PAPER.** Suppose a strongly connected
synchronizing n-state automaton has |S|=n-m>=2 and c(S)>=L. Put
T=binom(m+2,2). If

    1 <= h <= L-m-1,
    0 <= b := T+h-L <= 3m-2,

then |P_h|<=b. In particular, for m=4 and L=12,

    |P_h| <= h+3,  1<=h<=7.

Proof. S is independent in P_h, so tau(P_h)<=m. Every vertex is reachable
from some state in S within m letters: on a shortest path to S's complement,
all preceding outside vertices are distinct, and there are m of them.
If a vertex has at least m+1 P_h neighbors, reach it from S in at most m
letters. Either that prefix already compresses S, or its (n-m)-image
contains the vertex and a neighbor. Compression then costs at most m+h<L.
Thus Delta(P_h)<=m.

If P_h had b+1 edges, the peeling theorem applied to any b+1 of them gives
p_(n-m)(P_h)>=b+1. The credited Frankl–Pin refinement gives

    c(S) <= T - p_(n-m)(P_h) + h <= L-1,

a contradiction. The use of p, rather than edge cardinality without a
sequence proof, is essential.

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--3-a-word-rank-bound-and-its-letter-consequence"></a>
#### 3. A word-rank bound and its letter consequence

**P4-RANK-TRANSFER — PROVED ON PAPER.** In a synchronizing automaton,
if an original word u has rank s>=2, every s-subset S satisfies

    c(S) <= |u| + n-s+1.

Strong connectivity is unnecessary. Let K_1,...,K_s be the kernel blocks
of u. If every vu with |v|<=d=n-s+1 failed to compress S, all such Sv would
be s-sets meeting each block exactly once. Their characteristic rows lie
in the homogeneous subspace whose s block sums are equal, of dimension
d. The trajectory spaces V_i=span{chi_S D_v: |v|<=i} cannot plateau while
contained there: a plateau is invariant under all letters, whereas a reset
row s e_q does not have equal block sums. Therefore dim V_d>=d+1, a
contradiction. This argument keeps multiplicities in D_v; they become
characteristic rows only under the assumed absence of compression.

In particular, if |S|=n-4 and c(S)>=12, **every letter has rank at least
n-2**. A letter of rank less than n-4 immediately compresses S; one of
rank n-4 gives compression within 1+5=6. If f has rank n-3, apply the
bound to Qf: a word v f with |v|<=4 compresses it. Then f v f has length
at most six and rank at most n-4. Rank below n-4 directly compresses S;
rank n-4 and the same bound compress S in at most 6+5=11. These exhaust
all smaller ranks. More generally a word of rank n-m+1 and length a
implies c(S)<=2a+2m+1 for every (n-m)-set S of size at least two.

<a id="problem4-general-rank-descent"></a>
#### 任意短词的迭代秩下降与稳定幂界

**纸面推论，全部参数。** 本节将前面的秩传递引理迭代使用；不声称这是
Problem 4 的精确界，也不要求强连通或 S 可达。设自动机同步，
|S|=n−m≥2，某个非空原字母词 u 的长度为 a、秩为 n−d，其中 d≥1。
则

\[
 c(S)\le
 \begin{cases}
 a,&d>m,\\
 2^{m-d}(a+d+2)-1,&1\le d\le m.
 \end{cases}\tag{RD1}
\]

d>m 时直接应用 u。d=m 时，秩传递引理给出 a+m+1，正好等于 (RD1)。
若 d<m，该引理的证明提供一个 |v|≤d+1 的词，使 v u 压缩 Qu。
故 u'=u v u 的长度至多 2a+d+1，秩亏 d'≥d+1。
对 m−d 归纳：d'>m 时 u' 直接压缩 S，其长度不超过 (RD1)；否则
右侧关于 d' 单调不增，所以

\[
 c(S)\le 2^{m-d-1}\bigl((2a+d+1)+(d+1)+2\bigr)-1
       =2^{m-d}(a+d+2)-1.
\]

这里的 u、v 和 u' 都是原字母词；没有把一个长词按一字母收费。
当所得界比 Frankl–Pin 界差时，只取两者较小者。

还有一个使用 u 的稳定秩的加强。设 u 的某个幂的秩至多 n−m，且
1≤d≤m。有限变换的像秩在稳定之前每次严格下降：若 Qu^j 与 Qu^(j+1)
大小相等，后者包含于前者，因而集合相等，之后不会再降秩。
所以至多 m−d+1 次幂就达到秩 n−m 或更低。再用一次秩传递，得到

\[
 \boxed{c(S)\le (m-d+1)a+m+1.}\tag{RD2}
\]

因此 ac(S,A)≥L 的候选若满足
(m−d+1)a+m+1<L，则 u 的稳定秩必须至少为 n−m+1。
这是对**每个实际短词**的必要条件，可以用于混合词；不允许在仅代表
单步的匿名输出归约上迭代字母来检查它。

例如 m=5、目标 L=15 时，(RD1) 排除秩亏至少四的字母；(RD2) 进一步
说明任意长度二、秩亏至少二的实际词，其稳定秩必须至少 n−4。
对于秩亏超过五的词，直接压缩已将其排除。
这一限制单独不能确定 F(r+15,r+10,r)；其值现由[余维五完整排除](#problem4-five-exact-fourteen)确定为十四。

`check_rank_descent.py` 用普通子集 BFS 检查 568 个同步输入上的 31976 次
秩下降界和 12294 次稳定幂界比较。输入包括二、三状态的全部同步双字母
自动机、C4 至 C9，以及重新生成的 (16,11,1) 二块实例；后者同时核对
精确 ac=14、到达词和重置词。这里的全参数结论来自上述证明，有限检查
只核对边界与实现。

```sh
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/check_rank_descent.py
```

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--4-exclusion-of-p3k4-including-the-11-edge-contradiction"></a>
#### 4. Exclusion of P3=K4, including the 11-edge contradiction

**P4-K4-EXCLUSION — PROVED ON PAPER.** For n>=8, an (n-4)-subset of a
strongly connected synchronizing automaton with c(S)>=12 cannot have
P3 equal to K4 plus isolated vertices.

Use the established necessary condition tau(P5)<=3 from
`the codimension-four reduction`,
with its symbolic justification in
`the odd-cycle refinement`.
The new edge caps and letter-rank bound above are the other dependencies.

Suppose P3=K4[D], D={0,1,2,3}. A short-pair graph cannot plateau before
becoming complete in a synchronizing automaton, by the pair recurrence.
Since |P4|<=7, P4 is K4 plus exactly one edge. That edge cannot have both
ends outside D, since tau(P5)<=3 and covering K4 already costs three
vertices in D. Relabel it as 04. Put J=Q\D and O=Q\(D union {4}).

For every letter f, f^(-1)(D) is a clique of P4, including pairs with
equal images. At least two distinct D outputs are available because f
omits at most two outputs. Hence this fiber is either contained in D or
is exactly {0,4}. In the first case J maps injectively into J (all
immediate kernels lie inside D); thus it permutes J, and D must map into
D as well. Strong connectivity requires a letter of the second kind.

For any such crossing letter f, the three inputs 1,2,3 map outside D.
Their output cannot coincide with any J input output, since that would
be an immediate kernel outside D. There are |J|-1 outside inputs still
mapping to J, with distinct outputs. Thus 1,2,3 all map to the single
remaining t in J. The two D images f(0),f(4) are distinct. The pair they
form is not in P2, since its inverse 04 is not in P3. But P1 contains
the triangle on {1,2,3}, so this pair has the form {0,x}, x in {1,2,3}.

We claim t=4. Otherwise 4 has a unique preimage p in O. If f(0)=0,
the inverse of the P4 edge 04 gives 0p in P5, and 0 has degree at least
five, contradicting Delta(P5)<=4. If f(4)=0, its inverse is 4p, disjoint
from D, contradicting tau(P5)<=3. Thus t=4. If f(4)=0, pulling back 04
now gives all three edges 41,42,43 in P5, so |P5|>=10>8. Therefore
f(0)=0. Relabel x=1. We have

    f(0)=0, f(1)=f(2)=f(3)=4, f(4)=1,
    f|O = pi, a permutation of O,
    {0,1} not in P2.

These conclusions, with a potentially different x, hold for every crossing
letter. Strong connectivity also supplies a letter g and p in O with
g(p) in D union {4}. No O input can map into D, by the fiber alternatives
above; hence g(p)=4. Such a g cannot be a crossing letter, which would
merge p with 1,2,3 outside D. Thus g preserves D and permutes J.

Since 01 is not in P2 while all pairs in {1,2,3} are in P1, g(0),g(1)
are distinct and one equals 0. The option g(0)=0 would pull back 04 to
0p in P5, again exceeding degree four. Therefore g(1)=0 and 1p lies
in P5. Set q=pi^(-1)(p) and r=pi^(-2)(p). Successively pulling back under
f gives 4q in P6 and 1r,2r,3r in P7.

P7 therefore contains the explicitly specified edges

    binom(D,2), 04, 1p, 4q, 1r, 2r, 3r.

Here p,q,r all lie in O. Among these twelve displayed entries the only
possible repetition is 1p=1r. Thus |P7|>=11, contradicting |P7|<=10.
This completes this branch without any search over thirteen-state DFAs.
It is a reconstructed explicit branch, not an identification of the
unavailable earlier conversation's unnamed P7 branch.

<a id="problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--finite-controls-and-reproduction"></a>

- `problem4_k4_controls.py` verifies the forced inverse edges for all 40,320

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer"></a>
<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--excluding-a-seven-cycle-at-the-sixth-short-pair-layer"></a>
### Excluding a seven-cycle at the sixth short-pair layer

10 October 2026. AI-assisted continuation; priority OPEN. This is a new
computer-assisted branch exclusion, with a uniform mathematical reduction
and two independent finite checking approaches. It is not Lean verified.
All lengths are original-letter lengths; all alphabets are arbitrary finite.

**P4-C7-SIXTH — PROVED ON PAPER (computer-assisted).** Let n>=8. In a
strongly connected synchronizing n-state automaton with an (n-4)-subset S
satisfying c(S)>=12, P6 cannot be C7 plus n-7 isolated vertices. Initial
subset reachability and a protected set are not required.

This excludes one further graph branch. It neither proves tau(P6)<=3 nor
determines F_bin(13,9,1) or F(13,9,1). The earlier repository theorem rules
out C7 at P5; the statement here concerns the later layer P6.

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--1-a-uniform-reduction-to-seven-subset-positions"></a>
#### 1. A uniform reduction to seven subset positions

Assume P6 is a seven-cycle C, with isolated vertex set J. The independent
(n-4)-sets are precisely

    F = {J union T : T is a maximum independent triple of C}.

There are seven triples: their cyclic gaps are 2,2,3. For every |w|<=5,
Sw belongs to F; otherwise w already compresses S or its image contains a
P6 edge, yielding compression within eleven letters. In particular S is
one member of F. Let R_i consist of its images through depth i.

Strong connectivity and synchronization imply the trajectory span has
dimension at least min(i+1,n): a plateau is invariant under every letter,
and reset words followed by state paths span all coordinate rows. Thus
R4 spans dimension at least five and contains at least five distinct sets.
Each letter maps these into F, preserving cardinality.

By the rank-transfer argument in
[the short-pair note](#problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling), every letter has
rank at least n-2. Its kernel pairs belong to C, so its nontrivial fibers
are disjoint cycle edges, at most two of them. Every J input is a singleton
fiber, distinct also from every core input fiber.

At most one J input can map into C. Indeed, two such inputs have distinct
images x,y in C, and the images of all R4 sets contain x,y. At most two
maximum independent triples of C7 contain a fixed pair. To check this
last fact, adjacent pairs occur in none; pairs at cyclic distance two
have two choices of a third vertex, and pairs at distance three have one.
Their characteristic rows, even after adjoining J, span dimension at
most two. But a map with nullity at most two sends a space of dimension
at least five to one of dimension at least three. Contradiction.

If no J input maps into C, the letter permutes J and maps C into C.
If exactly one does, say j0 maps into C, the other |J|-1 inputs have
|J|-1 distinct outputs in J. The remaining J output j1 must be supplied
by exactly one core fiber, since every output member of F contains J.
All other core fibers map injectively to distinct core outputs different
from the image of j0.

Therefore the action on F and on pairs whose two outputs lie in C is
represented exactly by a map on C union {j}: identify the *input* j0 with
j and the *output* j1 with j, and discard the other isolated coordinates.
For the no-crossing case fix j. This is a projection of one letter's
relevant data, **not** a conjugacy of its transformation. In particular,
powers of a projected map need not agree with powers of the real map;
no such power-based cut is used in either checker.

The eight-state representative has rank at least six, with kernel a cycle
matching of size zero, one, or two, and maps at least five of the seven
sets {j} union T back into that family. Conversely, we enumerate every
map satisfying these conditions, allowing extra maps if necessary.
This is a superset cover for every n>=8, not a finite-n extrapolation.

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--2-complete-letter-domain"></a>
#### 2. Complete letter domain

Label C as 0,1,...,6,0 and j as 7. Order the seven independent triples
by their integer bit mask:

    21, 37, 41, 42, 74, 82, 84.

Adjoin bit 128 to each. Each action has a seven-entry profile, with value
7 denoting EXIT (failure to lie in the family). There are

    8! + 7*(8P7) + 14*(8P6) = 604800

maps with a permitted kernel: the empty matching, seven one-edge
matchings, and fourteen two-edge matchings. Exactly 1484 maps preserve
at least five members. Their relevant signatures number 896.

A signature records the subset profile; the image of each cycle edge
(a collision, another cycle edge, or a pair outside C); and every cycle
edge that has a non-cycle input pair as a preimage. These are all the
facts used in the next stage. No assumptions about a common kernel,
permutation letters, binary alphabets, or a chosen early-layer chain
are imposed.

The partition/injection generator enumerates all 604800 maps once.
An independent generator enumerates all 8^8=16777216 literal transition
rows and filters by rank and pairwise kernel membership. The sorted
1484 retained rows agree byte for byte. Their displayed subset images
and all signature fields are independently reconstructed by Python.

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--3-two-interacting-exact-distance-requirements"></a>
#### 3. Two interacting exact-distance requirements

Let d_i be the shortest EXIT distance from family member i in the actual
alphabet. Synchronization makes all seven values finite, between one
and seven. Every integer from one to max(d_i) occurs along a shortest
exit path. Relabel the cycle so that S is position zero; rotation is
transitive on the seven triples. Since EXIT in at most five letters
would compress S within eleven, d_0>=6. There are exactly 3960 possible
vectors satisfying these elementary constraints.

Let e_k be the actual shortest merging length of cycle edge k. Each lies
in {1,...,6}; every other distinct pair has merging length at least seven.
For a letter with subset profile a, its compatibility conditions are:

1. d_i <= 1+d_(a(i)), with d_EXIT=0.
2. If edge i collides immediately, e_i=1.
3. If edge i maps to cycle edge k, e_i<=1+e_k.
4. If a non-cycle pair maps to cycle edge k, e_k=6.

Condition 4 follows from 7<=1+e_k and e_k<=6. When a cycle edge maps
outside C, this relaxation imposes no extra upper-distance condition.
Immediate kernels are already constrained to C by the letter domain.

Exact finite distances also require a first-letter witness for each
position and each edge: for every i, some compatible letter has

    d_i = 1+d_(a(i)),

and for every k, some compatible letter either merges it with e_k=1 or
maps it to an edge l with e_k=1+e_l. The same alphabet must supply both
kinds of witness. For fixed distance vectors, include all compatible
signatures; this can only make finding the required witnesses easier.
Every genuine alphabet is contained in this pool, so failure of witness
coverage disproves that distance vector without limiting alphabet size.

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--4-exact-rejection-and-independent-check"></a>
#### 4. Exact rejection and independent check

Ignoring pair distances, only fourteen of the 3960 subset-distance
vectors admit all their required first-letter witnesses. Their compatible
signature pools have respectively 3 to 23 elements. The C++ checker then
exhausts all 6^7=279936 pair-distance assignments for each of those
fourteen vectors: **3919104 joint vectors, zero survivors**.

The independent Python audit generates the subset vectors as multiset
permutations and uses reverse breadth-first search to identify the same
fourteen. It searches the full pair-distance domain by depth-first
assignment, pruning only when a partially specified vector has no
compatible supplier for some required descent. It visits **4946 partial
nodes**, including its candidate roots, and finds zero complete solutions.
Every pruned branch fails a necessary local inequality or an explicitly
required supplier; this is exhaustive arithmetic, not a solver status.

Both checkers accept an artificial positive control with subset profile
(1,2,3,4,5,EXIT,EXIT), pair action (1,2,3,4,5,MERGE,MERGE), no forced-six
constraints, and both distance vectors (6,5,4,3,2,1,1). The control tests
that the distance rejection is not caused by a blanket rejection bug;
it is not claimed to be an automaton letter.

The empty intersection of the necessary conditions contradicts the
hypothetical automaton. This completes the computer-assisted proof.
The normalized-action reduction in Section 1 supplies the all-n coverage.

<a id="problem4-problem4-c7-sixth-layer--reproduction"></a>
#### Reproduction

From the repository root, with Python 3.10+ and a C++17 compiler:

```sh
python3 run.py c7 --threads 8 --independent
```

No generated binary, cache, SAT output, or regenerated action table is
committed. Sources and exact counts suffice to regenerate the small table.
The initial SMT reconnaissance gave UNSAT, but is not a proof dependency.

<a id="problem4-sixth-layer-three-cover"></a>
### 第六层三点覆盖：完整九核心排除

**计算辅助证明；2026-10-12；任意有限字母表。** 设自动机强连通且同步，
$n\ge8$、$|S|=n-4$。若 $c(S)\ge12$，则

$$
\boxed{\tau(P_6)=3.}                                      \tag{TC6}
$$

这里 $P_h$ 是长度至多 $h$ 可合并对的图，$\tau$ 是最小顶点覆盖数。
不要求 $S$ 是可达全状态像，也不要求有保护点。结论将此前只排除 $C_7$ 的
第六层结果推广到整个四点覆盖分支。它没有把 $(13,9,1)$ 的上界降为十一。

#### 完整归约到六、七点核心

$S$ 在 $P_6$ 中独立，所以 $\tau(P_6)\le4$。若有两点覆盖，则其补集是
大小 $n-2$、压缩长度至少七的集合，与 Frankl–Pin 的余维二上界六矛盾。
因此只须排除 $\tau(P_6)=4$。

记 $G=P_6$，$\mathcal F$ 为全部最大独立 $(n-4)$-集，$W$ 为其特征行的
实数线性张成空间。对 $|w|\le5$，$Sw\in\mathcal F$：否则在该前缀之后
至多再用六个字母即可压缩，违背 $c(S)\ge12$。轨道空间
$V_i=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb R}\{\chi_SD_w:|w|\le i\}$ 在达到全空间前
不能停滞；停滞将使其对每个字母不变，而同步和强连通给出所有 $s e_q$。
故 $\dim W\ge\dim V_5\ge6$。

从 $S$ 到任意状态的最短状态路径至多四步。因此深度四的这些最大独立集
已经覆盖 $Q$。固定最大独立集 $I$，令 $C=Q\setminus I$，$|C|=4$。
每个最大独立集都是 $(I\setminus N_I(T))\cup T$，其中
$T\subseteq C$ 独立且 $|N_I(T)|=|T|$。由覆盖性，这些紧交换集的并是 $C$。
[紧交换与匹配等号引理](#problem4-short-pair-span--2-rank-of-maximum-independent-sets)
给出 $B=N_I(C)$ 满足 $|B|\le4$；若等于四，$C,B$ 间有完美匹配，
每个最大独立集在四个匹配对上各取一点，其行秩至多五，矛盾。
所以 $|B|\le3$。

$I\setminus B$ 全部孤立；$C$ 的每个点在 $I$ 中有邻点，否则原覆盖并非
最小；$B$ 中各点也非孤立。因此非孤立核心恰为 $C\cup B$，大小 $r\le7$。
每个核心最大独立集大小为 $r-4>0$；所有孤立坐标恒为一，可由核心坐标之和
除以 $r-4$ 恢复。全图行秩等于核心行秩，故 $r\ge6$。

由[短对边数界](#problem4-problem4-short-pair-peeling--2-uniform-short-pair-edge-cap)，
核心还满足 $\Delta\le4$、边数至多九。完整分类域因此是：
$r=6$ 或 $7$，没有孤立点，独立数 $r-4$，每点属于某个最大独立集，
最大独立集行秩至少六，以及上述度数和边数限制。这里没有预设核心连通。

`problem4_tau4_core.cpp` 穷尽所有 $2^{15}=32768$ 个六点标号图和
$2^{21}=2097152$ 个七点标号图，分别留下 540、13212 个标号图，即两个、
七个同构类。每个同构轨道还与下表的核心逐一匹配，确保距离计算使用的九个
输入与完整分类无遗漏地对应。秩计算模 101 是精确计算：行重至多三，任意相关子式由 Hadamard
界满足 $|\det|\le3^{7/2}<101$，所以非零整数子式不可能模 101 消失。
独立的非同构图 atlas 加有理数消元复核得到相同九类。

下表编号与两个字母枚举器一致，顶点从零编号；$f$ 是最大独立集数。

#### 对任意状态数完整的单步字母表示

设孤立集为 $J$。九类图的任意固定核心对最多属于两个最大独立集；六点核心
最多一个。这一属性在完整图枚举的所有幸存图上核对，未作为分类的预设剪枝。
每个实际字母的秩至少 $n-2$，且其核对属于 $P_1\subseteq G$。所以 $J$ 的
输入全是单点纤维，与核心纤维的输出也不同。

一个字母至多把一个 $J$ 输入送进核心。否则两种不同核心输出将同时出现于
所有深度四轨道的像中；这些像仍在 $\mathcal F$ 中，其张成空间至多二维。
但 $\dim V_4\ge5$，字母的零空间至多二维，所以像空间至少三维，矛盾。

若没有这种输入，字母置换 $J$ 并保持核心。若恰有 $j_0\in J$ 跨入核心，
其他 $|J|-1$ 个孤立输入占据不同的孤立输出；唯一剩余孤立输出 $j_1$ 必须
由恰好一个核心纤维供给，因为每个安全像包含全部 $J$。
分别把输入 $j_0$、输出 $j_1$ 标为同一符号 $j$，即可用 $r+1$ 个位置表示
该字母相关的单步数据。没有跨入时固定 $j$。

表示的秩至少 $r-1$，碰撞块是核心的团，总亏秩至多二：允许一个二点块、
两个不交二点块或一个三点团，也允许置换。深度四已有至少五个不同集合，
所以至少五个 $\{j\}\cup T$ 被送回同一最大独立集族。
枚举所有满足这些条件的转移行，覆盖每个实际字母，允许保留额外行。
这个表示不是变换的共轭，**不能把不同字母的 $j$ 当成同一实际状态迭代变换**。
下面只使用单步子集、核心对动作，以及真正的状态商图。

#### 最短距离与强连通的共同约束

令 $d_i$ 是从第 $i$ 个最大独立集退出该族的最短距离。同步性保证
$1\le d_i\le f$；最短退出路径保证层数 $1,\ldots,\max d_i$ 不缺层。
初始 $S$ 至少五步不退出，所以 $\max d_i\ge6$。
令 $e_k\in\{1,\ldots,6\}$ 是第 $k$ 条核心边的实际最短合并长度。
不属于 $G$ 的不同状态对，其合并长度至少七。

给定 $d,e$，一个字母签名必须满足：

1. $d_i\le1+d_{f(i)}$，其中退出位置的距离为零。
2. 若核心边 $k$ 立即碰撞，则 $e_k=1$；若映为核心边 $l$，则
   $e_k\le1+e_l$。
3. 若不属于 $G$ 的输入对映为核心边 $l$，则 $e_l=6$。

同时，每个 $d_i$ 必须有兼容字母实现一步下降；每条核心边也必须有兼容字母
立即合并或实现 $e_k=1+e_l$。将所有兼容字母同时纳入只会扩大可用字母表，
因此供给不足可排除该距离向量，不需要给实际字母表大小设上限。

还需要强连通性。把实际全部 $J$ 合并成商图的节点 $j$，保留每个核心点。
单步表示保留所有核心相关状态箭头；它可能漏掉的实际箭头仅是 $j$ 的自环，
闭包计算补全这些自环。对同一签名，把全部转移行的箭头取并；再对所有兼容
签名取并，所得有向图包含真实状态商图。若这个更大的图仍不强连通，则任何
实际字母表都不可能强连通。这里允许沿商图走路径，不把商图路径声称为某个
精确投影变换的迭代。

#### 完整计算与结果

`problem4_core_distances.cpp` 先枚举核划分及输出单射。独立的
`problem4_core_profiles_check.cpp` 逐一枚举所有 $(r+1)^{r+1}$ 个转移行，
九个域共 119087598 行；两者的每个签名和每个状态的箭头并集逐项一致。

主程序按非空距离层枚举全部 $d$，只在已赋层缺少兼容供给者时剪枝；
随后枚举每个 $e_k=1,\ldots,6$，只以已知不等式或供给不可能剪枝。
未赋距离采用可能范围，未知目标不冒充确定的短距离。完整向量最后检查
同一兼容字母池的全部距离供给和商图强连通性。这是有限域穷尽，不依赖
求解器超时或随机搜索。人工正例通过整个搜索，恒等动作负例不能退出。

核心本身**（闭集位掩码 63），与 $J\ne\varnothing$ 及强连通性矛盾。


交叉核对，需要 `z3-solver`，不作为上述穷尽推导的前提。本轮九个核心均完成
这一核对：七点核心的距离系统无解，两个六点核心的距离系统有解但加上所有
非空真割集必须有出边的条件后无解。六点正例另经逆向 BFS 重算距离吻合。

**下一步边界。** 对 $(13,9,1)$，现在确定 $\tau(P_6)=3$，于是
$2\le\tau(P_3)\le3$。若 $\tau(P_3)=3$，已有十二形状分类的额外覆盖数
假设全部满足；但表中的历史排除仍须逐项证明。$\tau(P_3)=2$ 也仍需处理。
本定理不自动排除这两条路线，两个极值的区间仍是 $[11,12]$。

<a id="problem4-four-cover-late-layers"></a>
### 余维四：四点覆盖的后续层统一加强

**计算辅助证明；n≥8、强连通同步、任意有限字母表。** 若 |S|=n−4，
h≥6 且 τ(P_h)≥4，则

\[
 \boxed{c(S)\le h+5.}\tag{TC-h}
\]

这将既有一般界 h+6 在这些层统一缩短一步。等价地，对
L∈{12,13,14,15}，

\[
 c(S)\ge L\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\tau(P_{L-6})=3.
\]

上式下界三来自余维二的 Frankl–Pin 上界六：若 h≥6 而 τ(P_h)≤2，
就有一个 (n−2)-独立集至少七步不压缩，矛盾。这里没有改变 Problem 4
的初始像或保护点条件，也没有据此断言某个新参数的精确极值。

**为什么仍是完整九核心域。** h≥10 时，余维四的一般压缩上界十五
已经不超过 h+5。只须考虑 h=6,7,8,9，反设 c(S)≥h+6。
τ(P_h)>4 时 S 不独立，直接在 h 步内压缩，所以只需 τ(P_h)=4。
全部深度至多五的像都是最大独立 (n−4)-集，轨道行秩至少六；强连通性
还使深度四的这些像覆盖全部状态。上一节的紧交换与匹配等号论证因此
仍给出恰为六或七点的非孤立核心，独立数为核心点数减四，最大独立集
行秩至少六，且每个核心点属于某个最大独立集。

从 S 到每个状态至多四步，故最大度仍至多四。取 L0=h+6，短对边数
定理的 b=15+h−L0=9，且 h≤L0−4−1，9≤3·4−2；所以边数仍至多九。
这些恰是上一节完整图分类使用的全部条件，故仍只有同一张表的九个核心，
并未只抽取后层可能核心中的一部分。

因为 c(S)≥h+6≥12，每个字母仍有秩至少 n−2；核心内点对属于至多两个
最大独立集。因此跨入核心的孤点输入至多一个，独立输入/输出孤点标签的
单步表示、全部字母生成域及状态箭头并均与上一节相同。n≥8 保证六、七点
核心之外实际有孤点，故后面的核心闭集确实是非空真闭集。

**后续层的完整共同距离检查。** 子集距离仍满足 max d_i≥6；核心边距离
改为 e_j∈{1,…,h}。若非核心边输入对映到核心边 j，就由其合并距离至少
h+1 得到 e_j=h。其余单步不等式、所有距离下降供应及强连通性检查不变。
程序的 `--pair-cap h` 同时替换这两个 h，以及未赋距离的供应上限；
没有只改循环上界而遗留原第六层强制值。

| h | 核心 0 的共同距离向量 | 核心 1 的共同距离向量 | 其余七核心 | 强连通候选 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 6 | 72 | 6 | 均为零 | 全部为零 |
| 7 | 20 | 12 | 均为零 | 全部为零 |
| 8 | 4 | 4 | 均为零 | 全部为零 |
| 9 | 0 | 2 | 均为零 | 全部为零 |

所有非零共同距离池的字母箭头并都保持整个六点核心，闭集掩码仍为 63。
因此它们违反强连通性，不能把这些非零数当成实际自动机见证。
第七至九层分别用正序、逆序的边距离赋值完整计算，所有子集向量、共同
距离向量和强连通候选数逐项一致；没有对不同核心或不同层混用字母池。

本次还从源码重新枚举六、七点的全部标号图，得到原来的 540、13212 个
合格图及九个同构类；独立逐转移行生成器与核分划生成器的全部签名和
逐状态箭头并再次逐项一致。默认 h=6 的 72、6、零强连通结果也复现。
改变边距离赋值顺序是搜索实现的交叉控制，不声称是另一套图分类证明。
这里未重新运行依赖可选 SMT 求解器的旧检查；结论来自已完成的整数穷尽。

由每个 h 的完整排除及 h≥10 的纸面上界，得到 (TC-h)。

```sh
python3 run.py tau4 --threads 4 --pair-cap 7
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/problem4_core_distances.cpp --threads 4 --pair-cap 8 --pair-order forward
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/problem4_core_distances.cpp --threads 4 --pair-cap 8 --pair-order reverse
```

仍未完成的保护集/轨道联合排除。

<a id="problem4-four-cover-third-layer"></a>
### 余维四：将四点覆盖界提前至第三层及第二层反例

**计算辅助加强。** 对 n≥8 的强连通同步自动机、|S|=n−4，前节的
(TC-h) 实际上对所有 h≥3 都成立：

\[
 \boxed{\tau(P_h)\ge4\quad\Longrightarrow\quad c(S)\le h+5
        \qquad(h\ge3).}\tag{TC-3}
\]

h=1 也满足相同不等式，但 h=2 不能加入：下面给出真实、可达初始集的
八状态反例，c(S)=8>2+5。这个非单调的层数边界不是检查器超时或遗漏造成的。
(TC-3) 仍只是一个条件压缩界，未改变 m=4,q≥14 的未解极值。

证明的无限状态归约与[次极大秩四类核心](#problem4-next-to-maximal-rank-cores)
和[余维五完整作用检查](#problem4-five-cover-late-layers)相同。这里只陈述
必须调整的条件，不能直接复用旧程序中“亏秩≤2”的假设。

h≥10 时已有 Frankl–Pin 界十五≤h+5。对 h∈{1,…,9}，反设
c(S)≥h+6。覆盖数只能等于四，最大独立集行秩至少六、至多七。
秩七是 C7 加孤点，已由完整纸面奇圈界排除。秩六给出六点核心两类、
七点核心六类；最大度四，短对剥离界仍为 |P_h|≤15+h−(h+6)=9。
所有字母至少保持一个秩五的最大独立集子族。

亏秩至少四的字母在六步内即可压缩 S，所以完整域允许亏秩零至三，
比旧域更大。恒一核块列的同一维数计算给出辅助孤点数至多 N−4≤3。
程序 `near_max_rank_actions.cpp --m4` 以这些参数重新生成全部作用；

签名及每个核心输入的输出箭头并；允许两个、三个辅助点的主生成域也
被包含在这次完整比较中。

每个 h 都完整遍历 43113 个退出层节点和 17374 个集合距离候选。

| 8 | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

这里的核心编号来自当前结构生成器，不沿用旧程序的全部九核心编号。
h=6,…,9 的联合数还复现了旧域结果；h=3,4,5 的零强连通结果给出新范围。
h=2 的 74 个必要候选本身不自动构成自动机；以下显式实例另行证明
其中确有可实现情形。

**第二层显式反例及纸面核对。** 取 Q={0,…,7}，五个字母的转移如下。

| 输入状态 | a | b | c | d | e |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 6 |
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 5 | 0 | 6 |
| 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 2 | 3 |
| 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 3 |
| 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 5 | 2 |
| 5 | 4 | 4 | 1 | 3 | 4 |
| 6 | 7 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 0 |
| 7 | 6 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |

初始集合 S={0,3,6,7}=Qa³，故可达。字母图强连通：从 0 经
0→1→5→4→2→3 可以到达全部六个核心点，经 0→6→7 到达其余两点；
反向用 1→0、2→3→5→1→0、4→2、6→0、7→6 可返回 0。
词 adbadcadbedcadbedcaaa 将 Q 重置为单点，直接按表复合即可检查同步性。

下面的对称势函数矩阵 H 对角为零；只列严格上三角部分。

| x | H(x,x+1),…,H(x,7) |
|---:|---|
| 0 | 1, 5, 8, 6, 2, 9, 9 |
| 1 | 4, 3, 2, 7, 8, 8 |
| 2 | 1, 2, 1, 7, 9 |

| 4 | 3, 6, 8 |
| 5 | 7, 7 |
| 6 | 10 |

对表中五个字母 f 和每个点对逐项代入，均有
H(x,y)≤1+H(f(x),f(y))。因此 H 是所有词合并长度的下界。
S 内六对的 H 值为 8,9,9,8,8,10，故 c(S)≥8；词 daadcaaa
压缩 S，给出 c(S)=8。

H≤2 的边恰为 01,05,14,23,24,25,34,35。其中 01,23 由 a 合并，
25 由 b 合并，34 由 d 合并；其余四对分别由 ca、cb、db、ad 合并。
所以 P2 恰是这八条边，6、7 为孤点。六点核心的全部最大独立集恰为
02,12,03,13,04,15,45，独立数二，因而 τ(P2)=4。反例的全部必要
性质均由转移表、显式词和势函数给出，不依赖搜索器是否找到了它。

`check_short_pair_core_bounds.py` 另外以逐起点点对 BFS、普通子集 BFS
独立复核这些数值和词；它也核对 Černý 奇圈的精确距离公式与 C5/C7
正反控制。本例的单点保护极值并非八：对保护点 0,3,6,7，ac 分别为
1,1,6,7，不能把纯压缩反例冒充原问题未解边界的下界。

```sh
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/near_max_rank_actions.cpp -1 4 --all-caps --m4
```
