第一条命令去掉 `--canonical-prefix` 给出未归约四层对照；第二条给出已完成的
深层对照。核心 106 的两种早分裂域和全部晚分裂前缀均已完整排除；
核心 10 和 12 的晚分裂全域也已完整排除，计数见前节。

<a id="problem4-isolated-prefix-orbits"></a>
#### 核心外同批新状态的有序列归约

**纸面归约。** 除了核心自同构，还可以使用固定核心和保护点、置换核心外
状态的对称性。已有生成器在每次首次出现新标签时，使用最小的未用标签；
因此，按首次出现方向分成的各批标签已排列好，但同一批内部仍可互换。
令有序前缀为 F₁,…,Fₜ，每个核心外状态 x 的列为
c(x)=(1_{F₁}(x),…,1_{Fₜ}(x))。只保留这些列按标签顺序字典序不增的前缀。
这使最早被某个后续方向区分出来的状态使用较小标签。

对任意前缀，排序这些列给出唯一代表。列的最早非零坐标同时确定首次出现
的批次，所以排序仍满足原先的首次出现规范化。初始三个或四个方向中的
核心外标签均单独首次出现，因而逐点保持；未使用的标签形成末尾的零列。
完整有序列已排序时，截断末尾坐标后的列仍已排序，所以代表的每个较短
前缀也保留，逐层筛选不会漏掉整个真实候选轨道。

设首次出现于第 i 个方向的批次大小为 bᵢ（从未出现者也算一批），完整
相同列 c 的重数为 d_c。一个代表在原先“仅规范首次出现”的域中恰代表

\[
 w_{\rm iso}=\frac{\prod_i b_i!}{\prod_c d_c!}.
\]

分子允许每个已确定的批次内部任意排列，分母去掉完全相同列的重复。
不能误用全部核心外状态的阶乘，否则会重新计入已由首次出现规则删除的
批次顺序。该置换与核心自同构分别作用在不交的状态集上，稳定子也逐项
分离，所以同时启用两种归约时，当前层权重为两个当前前缀轨道权重的乘积；
仍不能乘上父节点的权重。

全部行族、秩、短对、供应条件以及实际字母表检查随状态共轭一一对应，
故权重可用于恢复原 admitted、one、two、vectors、actions 等层计数。
实现选项为 `--canonical-isolates`，可以与 `--canonical-prefix` 独立组合。
它保留同层两个方向的顺序，不把一般线性空间换基当成实际前像供应。

独立控制逐一列出四个核心外状态、四个方向的全部 65536 个零一矩阵，
其中 13377 个满足原首次出现规则；再对每个矩阵显式检查全部 24 个状态
置换，得到 3876 个轨道。每个代表的上式权重恰等于原域中的轨道大小，
非代表全部拒绝，并检查了截断前缀仍为代表。

完整实际域对照取核心 106 的前缀 (12,18,33)。第四至第九层的加权初筛数
仍为 672、2131、1542、1035、9536、16664，存活数、距离向量数、投影数
也与原完整运行逐项相同，第九层归零。实际检查代表数为
118、350、245、187、2330、4713，其中最后两层较原来的 2347、4791 更少。
耗时 29.740 秒；本次证明覆盖与计数一致，没有测得墙钟加速，亦不重复
宣称新的数学分支排除。较难剩余域的原运行保持进行，没有因该对照重启。

```sh
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 11 --terminal-reachable --literal-prefix --canonical-prefix --canonical-isolates --initial-flag 12,18,33 --core 106 --threads 1
```

<a id="problem4-periodic-isolated-states"></a>
#### 长安全区间迫使短对图外的状态逐字母周期化

**一般参数的纸面必要条件。** 设 m=n−|S|≥1，A⊂S 非空，存在从 Q 避开
A 中某点的词，并且 ac(S,A)≥L≥2m+2。则每个字母 f 至多有 m−1 个
不在其功能图循环上的状态。事实上，若至少有 m 个这样的状态，稳定幂
的秩至多 n−m=|S|；像秩稳定前每一步严格下降，因此 rank(f^m)≤|S|。
严格小于时，f^m 已压缩 S。等于时，对所有 |v|≤m+1，Sv 都必须是
f^m 的 |S| 个核块的横截集，因为 |vf^m|≤2m+1≤L−1。
这些特征行落在核块坐标和都相等的 m+1 维空间。
但全状态避开排除实际轨道行空间的过早平台，故 dim V_(m+1)≥m+2，矛盾。

令 K 为 P_(m−1) 的非孤立支持。任一 f 的非周期点 x 在至多 m−1 步后
首次进入一个循环。若这一步数为 d，在该循环上可取 y 使 f^d(y)=f^d(x)，
且 y≠x。因此 {x,y}∈P_d⊆P_(m−1)，从而

\[
\boxed{Q\setminus K\text{ 的每个点在每个字母下都属于循环；特别 }
 Q\setminus K\subseteq Qf\quad(\forall f).}\tag{PI1}
\]

如果自动机还强连通，则每个点从 S 至多 m 步可达。由 L≥2m+2，
P_(m−1) 的最大度至多 m：否则到达某个度至少 m+1 的点后，当前大小
n−m 的像必同时含一个邻点，再用至多 m−1 步合并就产生过早压缩。
原 S 是 P_(m−1) 的独立集，所以该图有大小至多 m 的顶点覆盖 C。
核心外的每个非孤立点都邻接 C 中一点，故

\[
\boxed{|K|\le |C|+\sum_{x\in C}\deg(x)\le m(m+1).}\tag{PI2}
\]

因此对所有这些参数，全部字母的非周期状态都集中在同一个大小只依赖
余维的集合中。它没有断言其余点在整个字母半群下周期，也没有给出它们
可被删除的商模型；(PI2) 本身不把一般参数归约成至多 m(m+1) 个状态。

在当前十四状态、九个外部占用点的模型中 m=4、L=12，K 就是已经枚举
的 P3 核心。故可以在所有层排除遗漏任一核心外输出的字母，甚至无需
恢复全部匿名标签。核心标签已经显式固定，匿名标签只在核心外置换，
“全部核心外输出都出现”对此置换不变；这与在匿名代表上迭代字母有本质
区别。`--periodic-isolates` 实现 (PI1) 的这个单步必要条件，不声称它单独
足以保证每个核心外点周期。

独立控制遍历全部 287 个二至四状态变换，将稳定幂像与逐点合并支持比较：
每个非周期点和每个被遗漏的输出，都位于相应步数的短对支持中。
该控制验证功能图部分；长安全区间导致周期秩下界的推导仍是上述纸面证明。
单字母生成器还在两个五状态域中逐一枚举全部 6250 个真实变换，与包含
匿名输出格的投影生成器比较保留的距离签名及箭头并，检查这一单步筛选。
生成器还将同一条件提前到输出分配阶段：每个成员格的剩余核块数不能少于
尚须出现的核心外输出数，显式核心外输出不得跳过；全部显式输出处理后，
剩余匿名输出必须全部占用。提前筛选与原先完成映射后筛选在上述两个域中
逐项一致，包括禁止强制距离签名的情况；这是同一必要条件的实现优化。
核心 106 的完整三层运行启用该选项后仍为 4 个存活旗标、10 个距离向量、
427 个投影，耗时 130.622 秒；没有把相同计数声称为新的排除。
剩余前缀 (64,128,256) 的完整四层对照也已结束：提前实施必需输出筛选后，
73 个代表仍加权恢复 1451 个初筛选择、11 个旗标、30 个距离向量和
1281 个投影，耗时 1272.371 秒；四个旗标尚未分裂、七个在第四层分裂。
这与较弱筛选的完整计数一致，不是新的分支排除或测得的加速。
这与其三点覆盖结构相容：所有大小 n−3 的 P3 独立集都包含全部孤点，
已有辅助独立集像条件已会拒绝遗漏孤点的字母。本次新增筛选的潜在增益
在二点覆盖核心；核心 12 的较弱完整运行已经归零，加强运行保留作对照。核心 10 的
原域及加强域已分别完整归零，计数见[完整覆盖](#problem4-q13-remaining-cores)。

<a id="problem4-cyclic-core-relabeling"></a>
#### 核心外输出重排保留周期状态集合

**一般有限变换的纸面引理。** 设 f:Q→Q，K⊆Q，C(f) 为 f 的全部
周期状态。若 Q\K⊆C(f)，则对任何逐点固定 K 的置换 π，后复合
fπ（即先 f 后 π）满足

\[
\boxed{C(f\pi)=C(f).}\tag{PI3}
\]

证明：记 T=Q\C(f)⊆K。因为 π 逐点固定 T，且 C(f) 包含 K 外全部点，
π 保持 C(f)。f 在 C(f) 上为置换，所以 fπ 也在该集合上为置换。
从任意 t∈T 出发，只要 f 的轨迹仍在 T 内，fπ 的轨迹与之完全相同；
第一次进入 C(f) 时，π 只把落点变成该集合的另一个点。
因此 t 在 fπ 下也恰于同一步进入 C(f)，不可能成为新的周期点，证毕。
反向应用 π⁻¹ 可知，“所有 K 外状态周期且周期秩至少 n−m+1”这个
合取条件在全部此类输出重排下不变，即使代表本身不满足该条件也能判定。

取 K=P_(m−1) 的支持，前节长安全区间假设迫使上述合取条件成立。
这比只要求 K 外每个输出有前像更强。例如
f=[0,0,3,1,4]、K={0,1,2} 的两个核心外输出 3、4 都出现，但
3→1→0，故 3 不周期。该例说明已有单步输出条件不能替代 (PI3) 的检查。

单字母投影生成器逐点固定所有核心输出；其未命名输出只能在各自成员格
内重排，这些重排均固定 K。因此 `--cyclic-isolates` 可以对一个匿名完成
计算周期状态掩码，要求全部核心外点周期且周期秩至少 n−3（当前 m=4），
并精确保留通过条件的整个输出重排类及其箭头并。此选项包含原
`--periodic-isolates` 的必要输出筛选；后者仍可用于重现较弱筛选的旧计数。
这不允许在匿名代表上检查一般的字母幂安全性或混合词安全性。

还可以在分配输出之前精确实施这个条件。对任意有限变换，

\[
 Q\setminus K\subseteq C(f),\quad |Q\setminus C(f)|\le d
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists T\subseteq K,\ |T|\le d:\ f|_{Q\setminus T}
 \text{ 是 }Q\setminus T\text{ 上的置换}.\tag{PI4}
\]

正向取 T 为全部非周期点；反向中 Q\T 都已周期，所以非周期点至多 |T|。
对固定核分划，每个核块在 Q\T 中必须至多保留一个输入。每个成员格内
保留的核块数必须等于该格中 Q\T 的输出数。随后把块 B 分配给输出 y 时，
必须满足 |B\T|=1−1_T(y)；未使用的显式输出必须属于 T。
这些条件保证所余匿名输出与保留输入一一匹配，正好等价于 (PI4)。
实现把所有 |T|≤3 的核心子集存为至多 64 位的候选集合，并在每次分配后
删除不满足条件的 T；集合为空就立即回溯。这里不限制合法映射的循环长度，
也没有选择一个固定的 T 来替代全部可能的非周期集合。

独立控制对全部 3125 个五状态变换，逐一后复合固定前两点的六个置换，
共检查 18750 次；周期掩码由逐点五次迭代独立计算。
2412 次满足核心外周期条件并保持完整周期掩码，16338 次保持不满足。
另在两个五状态、三点核心的域中比较完整逐映射枚举与匿名投影的距离
签名及箭头并，分别含两个匿名标签和一个额外显式标签；同时检查原生
必需输出剪枝与禁止距离签名的组合。上述测试核对实现，(PI3) 的全部
参数结论来自纸面证明，尚未由此声称新的完整参数上界。
核块分配中的 (PI4) 筛选也分别在保留、移除完成映射后的周期检查两种
模式下与逐映射枚举比较，确认该提前筛选本身既不多留也不遗漏投影。

核心 10 的完整前三层使用 (PI3) 后，19 个初筛旗标中保留 7 个，
共有 13 个距离向量和 465 个投影，耗时 42.081 秒。这是三层必要条件域，
仍有候选，不作为该核心的完整十二步排除。
随后改用 (PI4) 在生成阶段提前筛选，完整重跑同一域得到逐项相同计数，
耗时 42.113 秒；这里核对数学域与实现一致，不宣称测得加速。
核心 10 的 (PI4) 加强十一层全域现已完成并归零，耗时 3566.611 秒。
各层初筛、旗标、距离向量及代表数均与前述完整对照相同；第三至十一层
投影依次为 465、2441、4693、6625、11230、94525、111150、157172、254992。
这是既已排除核心的加强核对。核心 106 的最后一个前缀 (64,128,256)
也已完成同条件的十一层检查并归零，计数见[完整覆盖](#problem4-q13-exact-eleven)。

```sh
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 11 --terminal-reachable --literal-prefix --canonical-prefix --cyclic-isolates --controls-only
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 3 --cyclic-isolates --core 10 --threads 1
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 11 --terminal-reachable --literal-prefix --canonical-prefix --cyclic-isolates --terminal-example --initial-flag 64,128,256 --core 106 --threads 1
```

<a id="problem4-stable-kernel-core"></a>
#### 稳定核落在短对核心内，进一步限制非周期数

**一般参数的纸面必要条件。** 继续采用 (PI1) 的假设。每个字母 f 至多有
m−1 个非周期点，所以 f^(m−1) 已进入稳定秩：所有点都映到循环上，
此后再读 f 不会产生新的合并。令 H_f 为最终能由 f 的某个幂合并的点对图。
那么 H_f 的每个非平凡连通块是一个完整核块的团，而且

\[
 H_f\subseteq P_{m-1},\qquad
 \boxed{n-|C(f)|=\tau(H_f)\le\tau(P_{m-1}).}\tag{PI5}
\]

第一式因为全部最终合并都已在 m−1 步内发生。每个稳定核块恰含一个
周期点，大小 b 的块贡献 b−1 个非周期点，也恰需 b−1 个点覆盖其团边；
不同块互不相交，故相加得到等式。该界与已有 m−1 界共同使用。
在核心 10 和 12 中，最小覆盖均为 {0,3}、覆盖数二，因此每个
字母至多两个非周期点，稳定秩至少 n−2。核心 106 的对应界仍为三个。

稳定核条件也能在匿名输出完成上精确检查。更一般地，固定图 G 的非孤立
支持 K。若某个有限变换 f 的全部最终合并对都属于 G，则对任何逐点固定
K 的输出置换 π，fπ 的稳定核与 f 完全相同；反向同理。因此
“全部稳定核对属于 G”是整个匿名输出重排类的不变量。

证明：每个非周期点 x 与其唯一同相位周期点最终合并，故它们都在 K。
取足够大的循环长度公倍数 N，使 ρ=f^N 是投影到 C(f) 的幂等变换。
它逐点固定 C(f)，把 K 映入 K，且在 K 外为恒等。因此 ρ 与 π 交换；
又因 ρ 是 f 的幂，它与 f 交换，故也与 g=fπ 交换。
由 (PI3)，C(g)=C(f)。对足够大的 h，g^h(x)∈C(f)，于是

\[
 g^h(x)=\rho g^h(x)=g^h\rho(x).
\]

因为 g 在 C(f) 上为置换，g 的稳定核恰等于 ker ρ，也就是 f 的稳定核。
用 π⁻¹ 得到反向不变性。此证明没有声称一般的短混合词或字母幂安全性
在匿名重排下保持。

实现中的 `--stable-kernel` 自动启用周期核心约束，并把原生非周期集大小
上界改为 min(3,τ(P3))。完整匿名映射用反复平方计算 f^k（k≥n）的核，
再逐对检查包含关系；没有把匿名完成当成一般短词代表。

核心 12 的完整三层对照中，原周期筛选保留 8 个旗标、48 个距离向量、
964 个投影；稳定核筛选仍保留前两项，但投影降为 745 个。两次初筛均为
73 个选择、13 个规范代表，耗时分别 149.764、97.602 秒；这些时间仅为
当次完整运行，不据此声称普遍性能提升。核心 106 的最后一个初始前缀
(64,128,256) 使用稳定核后保留 1 个旗标、6 个距离向量、84 个投影，
完整三层耗时 68.070 秒。核心 12 已由较弱完整域排除；其稳定核加强
十一层运行随后也完整归零，计数见[完整覆盖](#problem4-q13-exact-eleven)，仅作交叉核对。

<a id="problem4-stable-kernel-partitions"></a>
#### 稳定核的团分块刻画与原生赋值剪枝

**一般有限变换的纸面等价刻画。** 设 G 是 Q 上任意简单图，非孤立支持
为 K。对任意变换 f:Q→Q，以下条件等价：

1. f 的全部最终合并点对都属于 G。
2. 存在 Q 的一个分块 π，每块在 G 中为团（允许单点），f 将每块映入
   某一块，且诱导的块映射是置换。

证明 1⇒2：取 π=ker(f^n)。核在 n 步后稳定，所以 f 诱导良定义的块映射；
若两块的像相同，f^(n+1) 已合并它们，核稳定说明它们原本就是同一块。
有限块集上的单射是置换。每个非平凡核块为 G 的团。

证明 2⇒1：若 f 的幂合并两个点，则诱导的块置换的同次幂也把它们所在
两块合并。置换可逆，所以原来的块相同，两点之间即为 G 的边。

该刻画也直接给出匿名输出不变性：逐点固定 K 的输出置换保持每个核心
团块，并置换核心外单点块。它与诱导块置换复合后仍为置换；逆置换给出
反向包含。先取 π 为 f 的稳定核可得 H_(fσ)⊆H_f，再交换 f 与 fσ
得到等号，因而不仅可行性、连稳定核关系本身也保持。

`--stable-partitions` 在显式输出赋值时使用此等价条件，并包含
`--stable-kernel` 的完整完成筛选作为交叉控制。它枚举全部核心团分块，
核心外全为单点；这里不能把稳定核缺陷误限为单字母缺陷二。
每个实际一步核块必须包含于某个候选团块。给它赋输出时，记录对应
团块的像并保持函数性与单射性；没有候选分块可延拓时立即拒绝。
当全部显式输出赋完后，剩余输出都是不同的核心外单点。剩余一步核块
必须属于互不相同、尚未赋像的团块；这也充分，因为单射完成必诱导
有限块集上的置换。原来的单元容量条件继续保证这些输出逐点可分配。

这一筛选精确实现同一个稳定核条件，不另加自动机假设，也不以输出箭头并
代替实际变换的迭代。

**实现核对。** 七个新增完整小域覆盖三点团、两边星图、两条不交边、
带尾三角形和三条不交边，包括额外显式输出及非平凡匿名输出格。
原生团分块筛选在保留或移除最终稳定核过滤器两种模式下，均与逐变换
n 步迭代的距离签名及箭头并逐项一致，也核对禁止强制距离签名的情形。
累计全部投影控制为 265329 个变换、4380 个实际前像模式。
另在两种五状态图上穷尽变换及核心外的两个输出置换，共 12500 次核对，
其中 1020 次满足稳定核条件、11480 次不满足；核关系、周期集合及覆盖数界
全部一致。三条不交边另保留一个一步秩缺陷一、稳定秩缺陷三的正例
f=(1,2,0,0,3,4)，防止误用一步秩界截断稳定团分块。

两个实际三层域也完成原生/终检对照：核心 12 仍为 8 个旗标、48 个距离
向量、745 个投影；核心 106 的前缀 (64,128,256) 仍为 1、6、84。
原生运行分别耗时 141.424、70.038 秒；前者慢于只在完成映射后检查的
97.602 秒，因此没有据此宣称加速或重复启动同域的原生十一层搜索。
该实现保留为同一条件的独立核对；已完成的核心 12 加强全域使用终检版本。

```sh
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 11 --terminal-reachable --literal-prefix --canonical-prefix --canonical-isolates --stable-partitions --controls-only
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 3 --stable-kernel --core 12 --threads 1
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 3 --stable-partitions --core 12 --threads 1
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 3 --stable-partitions --initial-flag 64,128,256 --core 106 --threads 1
python3 run.py script scripts/problem4/upper_bound/slack_one_initial_flags.cpp --pairs --delay-cut --ranks --arrival --all-late-splits --depth 11 --terminal-reachable --literal-prefix --canonical-prefix --canonical-isolates --stable-kernel --terminal-example --core 12 --threads 1
```


此刻画还给出比覆盖数更细的一般界。令 κ(G) 为对 G 的所有团分块
求 Σ(B∈π)(|B|−1) 的最大值；等价地，κ(G)=|K|−θ(G[K])，其中 θ
为最少团分块数。稳定核本身是一种这样的分块，因此在 (PI5) 假设下

\[
 n-|C(f)|\le\min\{m-1,\kappa(P_{m-1})\}
 \le\min\{m-1,\tau(P_{m-1})\}.\tag{PI6}
\]

后一不等式因为任意独立集与每个团至多相交一点，故 θ≥α。
特别地，G 无三角形时，所有非平凡团块都是互不相交的边，κ(G) 就是
最大匹配数 ν(G)。例如五圈有 τ=3 而 κ=2，此时每个字母的非周期数
至多二。这个推论适用于任意满足前述假设的参数；它仍是必要条件，
没有单独给出 Problem 4 的全参数精确值。

<a id="problem4-active-seven-cycle-probe"></a>
<a id="problem4-active-seven-cycle-probe--bounded-active-seven-construction-probe"></a>
### Bounded active-seven construction probe

At n=13, a fixes states0..5 and has rank6 on6..12; b cycles0..6 and
has any permutation on7..12. Up to simultaneous relabelling of7..12,
all b permutations have the eleven integer-partition cycle forms of6.
The domain is closed under that relabelling, so these11 canonical b
rows cover the entire stated domain, including identical-size cycles.

A rank6 function on seven active states has exactly one two-point
kernel, six distinct target values and one omitted target. Choose its
kernel in21 ways, omitted target in7 ways and output bijection in6!
ways. Thus each b form has105840 a rows; all11 forms have1164240
rows. Every literal a is dumped and independently regenerated in Python,
including uniqueness and hashes. This is not a cover of all binary
automata and does not exclude F_bin(13,9,1)=12 globally.

The primary implementation checks strong connectivity by forward and
reverse reachability. It computes every pair distance by reverse BFS.
A nine-set has compression length at least12 exactly when it contains
no pair of distance at most11. It tests all715 nine-subsets. If any
survived, it would then test actual Q-to-S reachability and intersection
of every image through11, followed by exact attaining/reset words.
Uninvoked candidate code is not a positive certificate.

The independent implementation checks strong connectivity by Boolean
transitive closure and computes pair distances by forward relaxation
to a fixed point. An independent nine-subset of P11 exists exactly
when P11 has a vertex cover of size at most4. Its exhaustive branching
test picks an uncovered edge and branches on deleting either endpoint;
depth4 suffices for the complete cover decision. Cycle/identity,
cycle/constant, identity/constant and clique/star controls are checked.

Every strongly connected synchronizing row pair in this bounded domain
compresses every nine-subset within11. No pair even reaches the initial
reachability/avoidance stage. This eliminates the active-seven rank-(n-1)
generalization route tested here; it is not an arbitrary-alphabet or
unrestricted transition-table theorem, and does not change either F
interval. The source has no solver dependency or time-limit negative.

<a id="problem4-b1-b2-inverse-union-exclusion"></a>
<a id="problem4-b1-b2-inverse-union-exclusion--generalizing-the-fixed-parameter-inverse-domain-test"></a>
### Generalizing the fixed-parameter inverse-domain test

This is an auxiliary, conditional argument at `(n,s,r,ac)=(13,9,1,12)`.
It gives neither a numerical extremum nor an alphabet separation. The accepted paper remains a partial answer. The frozen baseline
is checkpoint20261011_01. All24 selected negative geometries are conditional
exclusions only, and do not change either F(13,9,1) bound.

Use the already audited entrance-fibre inventory, the cover
`H={0,1,2}` of `P5`, and the bound `|P1|<=4`. For a retained B1/B2 third
geometry, every actual image through depth eight is a nine-set containing
`A={3}` and meeting `B,C,D` once. Its frame intersection `J` is therefore
mandatory through depth four. The mandatory-core isolation argument makes
`J` isolated in `P7`. The checker explicitly verifies that `J` is disjoint
from `H` for each selected geometry. No disjointness premise is
silently transferred from the older B3 computation.

For every actual letter, its three preimage fields and exact kernel occur
in the independently audited native field/kernel inventory. The actual
immediate-pair graph `P1` is the union of these kernels over the actual
alphabet. Thus enumerate the whole union closure of the native kernel
masks, retaining unions of at most four pair edges. This is complete for
arbitrary finite alphabets: every partial union of a true union also has
at most four edges, so iterative union closure cannot omit it. A zero
union is impossible for a synchronizing automaton with more than one
state, since it would make every letter a permutation.

The independent checker obtains the same graph catalogue differently:
it tests every nonempty edge subset of size at most four in the union of
the native kernels. Such a subset `G1` is a union of native kernels iff
the union of all native kernels contained in `G1` equals `G1`. This test
does not require guessing an alphabet or bounding its size.

Fix one proposed graph `G1`. Every actual letter kernel is a clique-union
subgraph of `G1`. Set `G=G1 union K_C union K_D`, which is contained in
`P3`. Each letter is injective on the ten inputs outside `H`; their images
form a ten-set independent in `G`, since an edge between them would lift
to a `P4` edge outside the cover `H`. Every image of a `J` input must be
isolated in `G` on the full available output set `Qf`: an available
neighbor would lift to a `P4` pair incident to `J`. This includes outputs
of kernel blocks lying wholly in `H`.

An exact kernel block lies in a unique input atom of the three preimage
fields. Classify blocks as outside non-J, J-singleton, or H-only. Assign
distinct output states of the corresponding output atom to the blocks.
Equivalently color outputs 0 (omitted), 1 (outside non-J block), 2
(J-singleton), or 3 (H-only block), imposing independence of colors 1/2,
isolation of color 2 among all positive colors, and equality of input
block and output color counts in every atom. Independent atom/type
bijections prove this is an exact description of the constrained
one-letter domain. It imposes no all-word safety sufficiency claim.

The generator colors active graph vertices and uses residual atom quotas
on isolated vertices. The independent checker chooses literal ten-state
independent sets, all subsets of their three-point complement for H-only
outputs, and all eligible `|J|`-subsets for protected outputs. It then
matches full atom/type quotas. For every input block, the union of targets
in its atom/type over these literal assignments gives exactly its
possible arrows. The checker separately rebuilds clique-union kernels
from all edge subsets of each proposed `G1`.

Every actual alphabet must supply the three entrance preimages
`pre(A)=B`, `pre(B)=C`, and `pre(C)=D`; suppliers may coincide. A missing
supplier rejects a graph class. Otherwise form the union of all allowed
arrows over all allowed letters. A nonempty proper set closed under these
arrows prevents strong connectivity for every actual alphabet. A strongly
connected maximal graph is retained as an overapproximation; it is not
a realization, nor a proof of synchronization, safety, or S reachability.

Canonical D rejection covers all labelled copies because a permutation
within the H,B,C membership cells transports D, all fields and kernels,
the mandatory frame intersection, the graph catalogue, and every proper
closed set. The checker enumerates these D copies and verifies the
transport. Exclusion applies to all such nine-sets, so in particular to
the actual reachable images required by the article. Omitting the
reachability restriction here only enlarges the tested domain.

The certificate selects exactly 24 negative geometries and one retained
control. Selection is explicit in b1_b2_inverse_union_scope.json; no
budget-limited exploration is used as evidence. The generator and checker
run without a timeout. The independent checker also reconstructs the
complete covered native kernel catalogue before testing immediate-graph
unions. The retained control is not asserted to realize an automaton.

Complete composition keeps all four older binary profile-cut lists. It
leaves112 unrestricted B1/B2 geometries,99 binary geometries,95 binary
typed families and437 profiles. Both previously remaining joint counts
(binary18, unrestricted20) are unchanged. Every input geometry and its
full labelled D orbit are checked; no individual safe image or maximal
transition graph is substituted for an actual alphabet.

Local corruption controls must reject missing graph classes, invented
supplier decisions, altered literal arrows, invalid closed sets, changed
mandatory cores and false kernel/field catalogues. The two complete
enumerations and the previously exhaustive labelled-map controls justify
the one-letter criterion. Any numerical F value, alphabet separation or
all-parameter conclusion remains outside this certificate's scope.

### Fourth entrances for the five nonsingleton D types in B0/C14

Conditional on n=13, |S|=9, ac(S,{3})=12, strong connectivity and
synchronization. Put A={3}, B={0}, C={1,4}, K={1,2} covering P5.
This classification concerns precisely D12,D15,D24,D25,D125. Digits
denote state sets. D2 is already excluded for every alphabet; D5 is
excluded only in binary by the separate complete D5 certificate.

The earlier complete covered Boolean inventory has pre(C) in
{A,B,C,D} for these five D geometries. A letter maps D into C, and
another maps C into B, so D is a clique in P2. Each preimage of D is
therefore a clique in P3 and has at most one point outside K.

Every image through eight meets D once. A preimage R of D meets every
image through seven once. It contains3 only if it is A; distinct
one-count fibers are incomparable, by the four-step strong-connectivity
reachability argument. If all preimages of D were among A,B,C,D,
their nonempty proper union would be backward closed under every
letter. Strong connectivity supplies a fresh E outside those fibers.

The trajectory span V7 has dimension eight. Its annihilator has
dimension five and restriction to O=Q minus A is injective. The four
columns 1_O,B,C,D are independent. The earlier covered Boolean
classification in their span lists only B,C,D, so fresh covered E is
independent. Thus 1_O,B,C,D,E is a basis. Every further outside
preimage of D is a Boolean column in this span, with functional
8*c0+cB+cC+cD+cE=1. All companions are retained before the cover and
incomparability tests; no common-E assertion is assumed.

The complete literal family consists of nine-sets containing3 and
meeting B,C,D,E once. It contains every actual image through seven.
Its intersection is mandatory through four, hence isolated in P7 by
the mandatory-core theorem. Pair and triple D/E endpoints are not
individually protected unless they occur in that intersection.

Letters are classified by pre(A),pre(B),pre(C),pre(D). Exact four-bit
output atoms preserve shared1 or4 between C and D. Empty input groups
are allowed. Singleton output atoms force kernel pairs, which must
meet K, avoid the mandatory core, and number at most four. Binary
incoming capacities and the combined four-pair limit are applied only
to binary pairs, with at least one letter supplying E. An individual
all-alphabet exclusion instead uses all24 earlier field tuples without
binary capacities. A field admission is not an automaton model.

The independent checker enumerates literal E choices, all outside3
masks, augmented ranks and actual nine-set intersections. The prime
10007 exceeds the absolute value of every Boolean minor of order at
most six (at most6^3=216), so modular rank equals rational rank.
Exact rational coefficients, uniqueness and all labelled orbits are
also checked. This is auxiliary research, not a new global F value.

### Singleton B and a two-point C completing the H-cover

9 October 2026. Conditional binary exclusion at (13,9,1), outside the
article/release. Assume ac(S,{3})=12 with |S|=9, strong connectivity
and synchronization. Normalize H={0,1,2}, B={0}, C={1,2}.

All short images contain 3,0 through depth ten and meet C once
through nine. The established H-cover of P5 and isolation of 0 in
P6 imply that C itself covers P5: an edge cannot use 0. Thus no pair
outside C merges within five letters. Each letter is injective on
Q minus C. Also both protected states 3,0 are isolated in P6.
Put R={4,...,12}, J=R minus {4}. Initial reachability is unnecessary.

The complete third inventory has exactly two orbits, D={4} and
D={1,4}, with fourteen and three earlier letter-profile pairs. They
are common third fibers in this geometry. To see this directly, an
outside preimage of C lies in span{1,chi_B,chi_C,chi_D}. The remainder
outside B,C,D meets S at least five times, so its Boolean coefficient
is zero. The private cells B, C minus D, D minus C make the other
coefficients Boolean. Since S meets B,C,D once, their sum is one.
Thus every preimage of C is A={3},B,C or D; no extra Boolean fiber
is omitted. D is a collision clique within two steps, since C itself
is an immediate collision pair under a C-merging letter.

<a id="problem4-b1-c2-h-cover-exclusion--d14"></a>
#### D={1,4}

The C-merging letter L has pre(B)=C, pre(C) a protected singleton,
and pre(3) the other protected singleton. Write p for its protected
predecessor of delta in C. It maps R to R bijectively: all nine R
inputs are outside C, their outputs lie in the nine-state R, and
outside injectivity forbids collisions. The other letter F permutes
{0,3}, has pre(C)=D, and sends {2} union J into R. Its restriction
to J is injective. These descriptions cover all three admitted pairs.

If delta=1, choose x=L^{-1}(4) in R. The protected pair {p,x}
follows L to {1,4}, F into C, and L to 0. Word L F L merges it
within three letters. Hence delta=2.

Write gamma=F4. If gamma=2, incoming C targets force F1=1;
state 1 then has only its own F-loop and no other incoming transition,
contradicting strong connectivity. (F1=2 would leave 1 with no input.)
Thus gamma=1. If some x in J has Fx=4, the pair {4,x}, outside C,
follows F to D, then F L merges it in three letters. Hence F(J)
avoids 4 and is exactly J, bijectively.

If F2 is in J, let r be its J predecessor under F and choose
x=L^{-1}(r) in R. Then {p,x} follows L to {2,r} and merges by F
in two letters. Therefore F2=4. Finally choose x=L^{-1}(4) again.
The protected pair {p,x} follows L F^2 to {1,F1}, contained in C
or already singleton. A further L merges it. Word L F^2 L has length
four, contradicting protected-pair isolation. All possibilities fail.

<a id="problem4-b1-c2-h-cover-exclusion--d4"></a>
#### D={4}

Put G={the pair12}. If both letters merge C to B, each has only
that immediate kernel: outside-C injectivity and pre(B)=C exclude
any C-to-outside collision. Each pre(C) is a singleton in {A,B,D},
so G is backward closed. This is incompatible with synchronization.

Otherwise let L be the C-merging letter and F the other one. If
pre_F(C)=C, its kernel is contained in G: C maps into C, protected
states permute, and R maps bijectively into R. The fresh D supplier
must be L, with pre_L(C)=D. Its kernel is exactly G, and its preimage
of C is singleton. Again G is backward closed and synchronization fails.

The remaining possibility is pre_F(C)=D. L has a singleton preimage
of C in {A,B,D}; write delta for its output. Incoming C targets force
F4=beta, where {delta,beta}=C. F permutes {0,3}, sends C union J
into R, and is injective on J. Under L every R output has an
outside-C predecessor: its R-inputs are R if pre_L(C) is protected,
or J union the unused protected input if pre_L(C)=D. There are nine
such outside-C inputs into R, mapped bijectively. Its sole predecessor
of delta is outside C too (protected or4).

If Fdelta=Fq for any q in J, choose outside-C L-predecessors of
delta and q. Their pair merges by L F, contradicting the C-cover.
Thus Fdelta has no J predecessor. If Fdelta=Fbeta, then the only
immediate F kernel is G, as is L's; singleton preimages of C again
make G backward closed. Exclude this nonsynchronizing alternative.

Consequently Fdelta is distinct from every other R-input output.
There are ten inputs C union J into nine R targets, with F injective
on J. Thus Fbeta=Fq for a unique q in J. This is the extra kernel;
its nine blocks map bijectively onto R. Put r=Fdelta; then F(J)=R
minus {r}. If q is not r, choose an outside-C F-predecessor x in J
of state q. The pair {4,x} follows F to {beta,q}, and a second F
merges it, contradicting the cover. Hence r=q.

Let u=L^{-1}(delta), and choose v=L^{-1}(4), both outside C and
distinct. Their pair follows L to {delta,4}, F to {q,beta}, and F
to a singleton. Word L F^2 has length three. This final contradiction
exhausts all fourteen admitted D={4} profile pairs. The unused
protected input mapping into R is included; no ordinary permutation
or injection is fixed in any case.

The earlier covered Boolean inventory gives pre(C) in {A,B,C,D}.
All three known outside fibers B,C,D are pairwise disjoint, so a
Boolean one-count column in span{1_O,B,C,D} is only B,C or D: the
ordinary cell contributes five and these three contribute one each
on an initial image, whereas a one-count column must contribute one.
This elementary statement is also independently checked in the old
inventory. Since C is a singleton, a supplying letter merges every
pair of D in one step. Every preimage of D is consequently a clique
in P2, and has at most one point outside K.

Images through eight meet D once, and every preimage R of D meets
images through seven once. A preimage containing3 must equal A,
by strong connectivity reaching all points from S within four steps.
Distinct outside one-count fibers are incomparable by the same reach
argument. If all preimages of D belonged to A,B,C,D, their proper

strong connectivity. Thus a fresh E exists. Local equality gives

basis restrictions1_O,B,C,D,E. Fresh E is independent because the
previous four-column Boolean one-count inventory has only B,C,D.

Every further preimage of D is either A or a Boolean one-count column
in this basis, with functional8*c0+cB+cC+cD+cE=1. Retain all companions;
never assume a common E across letters. The complete literal nine-set
family contains3 and meets B,C,D,E once. It contains every actual
image through seven. Its intersection is P7-isolated by the mandatory-
core theorem. A mandatory endpoint in a nonsingleton D(P1) or E(P2)
is therefore contradictory. If at most one cover point remains after
removing mandatory points from K, the old Frankl--Pin cover-floor
proof is contradictory independently of the alphabet.

Individual letters use exact membership atoms for outputs A,B,C,D
and inputs preA,preB,preC,preD. Since D is disjoint from A,B,C,
no overlapping-output shortcut is needed here, but D endpoints
must remain one atom with its actual capacity. Singleton target

and number at most four. All24 earlier individual column tuples

Only binary pairs use combined incoming capacities and the union
of forced kernels. Missing binary pairs never exclude arbitrary
alphabets. Geometry/field admission alone is not an actual automaton.

The generator uses exact rational Boolean coefficients and stabilizer
cell counts. The independent checker enumerates labelled E choices,

of order at most six have absolute value at most6^3=216<10007.

<a id="problem4-b1-e26-f7-seventh"></a>
<a id="problem4-b1-e26-f7-seventh--complete-seventh-entrance-admission-in-e26f7"></a>
### Complete seventh entrance admission in E26/F7

Conditional at n=13, |S|=9, ac(S,{3})=12, B={0}, C={1,4},
D={5}, E={2,6}, F={7}, K={1,2} covering P5.
The sixth branches considered here are precisely G={8},{1,8},{2,8}.
This is an investigation-only necessary classification, not an extremal
value or an assertion of automaton existence.

Every collision-free image through five meets G once. Thus every
preimage of G meets every image through four once. A preimage containing
3 equals {3}; otherwise the four-step images omit another state, contrary
to strong connectivity reaching every state from S in at most four steps.
Distinct one-count fibers are incomparable for the same reason.

The complete earlier sixth Boolean inventory has no companions in these
three branches. Every preimage of F is one of A,B,C,D,E,F,G. If all
preimages of G were also known, the nonempty proper union of these fibers
would be backward closed under every letter, contradicting strong
connectivity. Hence some letter supplies a fresh H.

Equality gives dim V4=5. The annihilator has dimension eight; restriction
to O=Q minus {3} is injective. The columns 1_O,B,C,D,E,F,G are independent.
The earlier complete Boolean inventory shows that a fresh one-count H is
outside their span. Therefore 1_O,B,C,D,E,F,G,H is a basis of this
restricted annihilator. Every further preimage of G is a Boolean column
in this span with one-count functional 8*c0+sum(ci)=1. All such columns
are retained explicitly before cover and incomparability tests.

G is a clique in P1 because F is a singleton and a letter maps G to F.
Every preimage of G is consequently a clique in P2. The P5 cover gives
|H minus K|<=1 and |H|<=3. No separate isolation is asserted for either
endpoint of E or of the overlapping G pairs.

The literal family contains all nine-subsets containing3 and meeting
each of B,C,D,E,F,G,H once. It includes every actual image through four.
Its intersection is therefore a mandatory core through four and is
isolated in P7 by [Isolation of the mandatory core at the reaching depth](#problem4-mandatory-core-isolation).

Each letter is recorded by the seven preimages of A,B,C,D,E,F,G. A source
can map only to an output with the same seven-bit membership signature.
The exact output atoms retain C/G's shared1 and E/G's shared2. Empty
input atoms are allowed. Singleton output atoms force kernel pairs;
these must meet K, avoid the mandatory core, and number at most four.
For binary pairs the two incoming capacities must cover every output
atom, their combined forced pairs must number at most four, and one
letter must supply H. Those binary conditions are not all-alphabet cuts.

The independent checker imports no generator. It enumerates every
literal H and all outside3 subset masks, checks augmented ranks modulo
100003, and checks the generator's rational coefficients literally.
All Boolean minors have order at most nine and square absolute value
at most 9^9<100003^2; the modulus is verified prime. Modular rank thus
equals rational rank. Full 5040-tuples of earlier individual fibers
are separately checked for every fresh or covered companion preimage,
without binary incoming-capacity constraints. These controls establish
whether an individual preimage is impossible for every alphabet.

The inventory and checker do not by themselves exclude a whole G, F, E,
third or joint geometry. A field admission is not a complete transition
row or an equality model. The manuscript and release are unchanged.

### Complete binary rows for the E26/F7 seventh survivors

Conditional hypotheses and complete seventh admission are specified in
[Complete seventh entrance admission in E26/F7](#problem4-b1-e26-f7-seventh). Seven typed binary survivors require actual rows:
G8/H9,H19,H29; G18/H9; G28/H9,H18,H19.

exact output-membership atom, and assigns both guard inputs to every
output except those occupied by mandatory inputs. The separate C++
enumerator assigns sources 0 through12 recursively, retaining exactly
the same constraints. Both enumerate empty domains literally.

The mandatory core is the intersection of all literal nine-sets meeting
B,C,D,E,F,G,H once and containing3. Every actual image through four lies
in this family. Pure-letter powers must therefore stay in this family
through four and preserve rank9 and3 through eleven. Mandatory points
must be isolated in P7; outside-K pairs must not merge through five.
These are necessary conditions and do not require an initial Q-to-S
word for a negative result.

One complete coupled checker uses forward and reverse state reachability
and reverse pair-preimage closure to a fixed point. The other uses
Boolean state transitive closure and scalar forward pair-distance
relaxation to a fixed point, with a different rejection order. Bare
cycle/identity, cycle/constant and identity/constant controls disable
conditional cuts and check synchronization and strong connectivity.
Actual conditional domains enable the cuts. Raw-row hashes and every
retained row's initial-image mask must coincide independently.

Only completed scan results can justify a binary negative. Individual
row domains and two-letter pair scans cannot exclude a larger alphabet.
An uninvoked prefix/reaching check is not evidence of a model. A positive
candidate must pass exact local subset BFS, strong connectivity,
synchronization and actual Q-to-S reachability before being accepted.

The sources, data and audits here remain outside the accepted article
and its release. No new extremal value is asserted by this note alone.

If L has a predecessor x of7, {u,x} follows L X to a singleton.

X predecessor x: x=5 for r=4, or x is ordinary for r at least8.

pre_X(C)=D={5}, pre_X(D)=E={6}, X6=5, and X2=X4=6.
Write X5=gamma in C. Its ordinary inputs {1} union J map into
T, injectively on J, with at most an extra kernel {1,r}, r in J.

For L, pre(C)={u}, u in {0,3,5}; write Lu=delta in C. Its
four singleton preimages of A,C,D,E use all P inputs. L maps T
into T, injectively on J, with at most an extra kernel {2,q},
q in J. These are K-cover consequences, not outside-C injectivity.
Since only two letters supply the C targets, strong connectivity
requires {delta,gamma}=C.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f24-exclusion--gamma4-delta1"></a>
#### gamma=4, delta=1

If X has an ordinary predecessor x of2, {5,x} follows X^2 to
a singleton, since X5=4 and X2=X4=6. Thus X omits2 and maps
J bijectively to J, with X1=Xq for a unique q in J. If L has
a predecessor x ofq, {u,x} follows L X to a singleton. Hence
L omitsq, maps J bijectively to T minus {q}, and L2=Lr for
a unique r in J. For r different fromq, outside-K L predecessors
of2,r follow L^2 to a singleton. Therefore r=q.

The remaining kernels are G={14,24,1q,2q}, a four-cycle between
{1,2} and {4,q}. L omits4,q and X omits1,2. Both letter images
are independent in G, so no distinct pair maps into G and every
immediate kernel lies in G. Backward closure prevents synchronization.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f24-exclusion--gamma1-delta4"></a>
#### gamma=1, delta=4

If L has a predecessor x of2, {u,x} follows L X to a singleton.
Thus L omits2, maps J bijectively to J, and L2=Lq for a unique
q in J. The distinct X(J) outputs form T minus {z}. If z is
neither2 norq, outside-K X predecessors of2,q follow X L to
a singleton. Hence z=2 orq.

If z=2, incoming coverage of2 forces X1=2. X permutes J.
Choose x in J with X^2 x=q. Then {5,x} follows X^2 L to a
singleton: X^2 5=2 and L2=Lq.

If z=q and X1=q, let r be the J predecessor of2. For r different
fromq, choose x in J with Xx=r; {5,x} follows X^2 L to a
singleton. If r=q, then X1=q and Xq=2. Here pre_X(F)={q}
and pre_(X^2)(F)={1}. The one-count conditions on SX and SX^2
force q,1 into S. As S meets C once,4 is absent; as S meets F
once,2 is present. But L2=Lq then collides two S states in one
step, contradicting safety. This uses actual image coordinates,
not a guessed reaching path or transformation multiplicities.

Otherwise X1=Xr for a unique r in J. If r differs fromq, choose
x in J with Xx=r. The protected pair {5,x} follows X^2 to a
singleton. The last possibility r=q again has kernels G. L omits
1,2 and X omits4,q, so the same backward-closed four-cycle
prevents synchronization. Every case fails.

All-pair mergeability is equivalent to synchronization: merging any

No finite-time timeout or necessary field admission proves a negative.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f2-exclusion"></a>

### The singleton fifth F2 is impossible in E6

9 October 2026. Conditional exclusion at n=13, |S|=9,
ac(S,{3})=12, for every finite alphabet. Fix B0,C14,D5,E6 and
the fresh fifth F2 of [Fifth entrances in the residual B0/C14/D5 branch](#problem4-b1-fifth-entrance). No whole E6 branch,
new F value or numerical alphabet separation is asserted.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f2-exclusion--correct-depth-and-rank"></a>
#### Correct depth and rank

Every image through six contains2. Thus ac(S,{2})>=7, and the
protected-pair bound ac(S,{2})<=4+d_2 implies d_2>=3. The point2
is isolated in P2. This is not P3 isolation; the earlier one-point
P3 compression-cover floor does not apply.

Strip2 from K={1,2}, which covers P5. The singleton {1} covers P2.
In particular every letter is injective on Q minus {1}, so has rank
at least12. Any nontrivial kernel consists of exactly one pair {1,q}:
a triple or two nontrivial blocks would collide two inputs outside1.
The set U={0,2,3,5,6} is isolated in P2. This follows from the
earlier depth bounds for0,3,5,6 and the just established bound for2.
Hence q is4 or is in J={7,8,9,10,11,12}.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f2-exclusion--a-short-pair-graph-argument"></a>
#### A short pair-graph argument

In a strongly connected automaton, if a singleton {c} covers P2,
then P1 has at most one edge. To prove this, suppose P1 contains
distinct edges {c,u},{c,v}. Every letter ell is injective outside c,
so T=(Q minus {c})ell has n-1 points. Also T is independent in P1:
a collision edge in T would have distinct predecessors outside c
forming an edge of P2, contradicting the singleton cover. The only
independent (n-1)-set in a graph containing those two edges is
Q minus {c}. Indeed, an (n-1)-set containing c omits only one state
and cannot omit both u and v. Thus every letter preserves Q minus
{c}, contradicting strong connectivity. This elementary argument
uses no synchronization premise or n=13 restriction.

Apply it with c=1. The earlier C-supplying letter maps C={1,4}
to0, so pair14 is an immediate kernel. It must therefore be the
only edge of P1. Let G
be the singleton pair-graph edge14. It is backward closed: each
letter has pre(C) equal to A3,B0,C14 or D5. A singleton pre(C)
supplies no distinct inverse pair, and a C14 pre(C) supplies only
the edge14 when its two outputs differ. All immediate collisions
are in G, so the reverse pair search never leaves G. The automaton
would not synchronize, contradicting the hypothesis. This already
proves the conditional exclusion.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f2-exclusion--independent-expanded-incoming-argument"></a>
#### Independent expanded incoming argument

As an adversarial cross-check, the same contradiction can be obtained
without using the short graph observation. If every letter kernel
were empty or14, the backward-closure argument above would contradict
synchronization. Some letter R therefore has kernel {1,q}, q in J.

Fix that letter R and its q. Consider any letter ell supplying an
incoming transition to1. Its pre(C) is A3,B0,C14 or D5.

If pre(C) is a singleton {u}, u in {0,3,5}, then ell(u)=1 and4
is absent from the image. Rank at least12 makes4 its only absent
output. Consequently q has a predecessor x, distinct from u.
The pair {u,x} follows ell R to a singleton, contradicting the
P2 isolation of the protected point u.

Suppose pre(C)=C and ell(4)=1. If ell(1)=1, output4 is absent;
again rank at least12 ensures q is present. If ell(1)=4, the
restriction to C is a permutation. Any collision would involve1,
but every input outside C maps outside C, so1 cannot collide with
one of them or with4. Thus ell is a permutation of Q and q is
again present. In both cases choose x with ell(x)=q. This x is
outside C. The pair {4,x} is outside the cover {1}, yet ell R
merges it in two steps, contradicting that {1} covers P2.

The only remaining way to supply1 is pre(C)=C, ell(1)=1,
ell(4)=4. Its preimage of1 is exactly {1}. Letters not supplying1
have empty preimage of1. Thus every letter's preimage of the
nonempty proper set {1} is contained in {1}. No state outside1
can reach1, contradicting strong connectivity. QED.

The proof uses synchronization to obtain R, strong connectivity
for the final incoming contradiction, and only length-two pair
premises afterward. It does not require a binary alphabet, choose
ordinary permutations or assume outside-C injectivity at an earlier
depth. Outside-{1} injectivity is derived here after P2 isolation
of2 has been proved.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f2-exclusion--complete-individual-letter-controls"></a>
#### Complete individual-letter controls

The generator enumerates the five disjoint output fields A,B,C,D,E
and their remaining field at n=7,8,9,13. Its row templates cover
all known nonempty preimages, including letters unused by any
binary parent pair. It assigns all injective outputs for inputs
outside1 and all allowed outputs for1, retaining both the C kernel
and every ordinary {1,q} kernel. It checks the protected immediate
kernel restrictions. No fixed ordinary permutation is substituted.

The independent checker reconstructs these assignments by selecting
the immediate kernel first and then injecting its quotient blocks
into the permitted target fields. It imports neither the generator
nor the fifth checker. For every full letter and every q in J it
evaluates the two displayed witnesses literally whenever that letter
supplies1 from a predecessor other than1. It also checks the inverse
closure of G. These are full individual-letter controls for the
symbolic proof, not a full thirteen-state transition-pair scan.

The singleton cover of P2 by itself is permissible: on three states,
letters [1,2,0] and [0,2,2] are strongly connected and synchronizing,
with P1={12}, P2={01,12}. This literal control guards against the
invalid claim that one-point P2 covers are impossible. It has a
different preimage structure from the thirteen-state branch.

An automaton is synchronizing exactly when all unordered pairs are

### Binary sixth singleton G2 after E6/F7 is impossible

9 October 2026. Conditional at n=13, |S|=9,
ac(S,{3})=12, B0,C14,D5,E6,F7,G2. Binary alphabet only.
This is a sixth-profile exclusion, not a whole E6/F7 branch
exclusion or an extremal F value.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g2-exclusion--the-correct-depth"></a>
#### The correct depth

Every image through five contains2, so ac(S,{2})>=6. The
protected-pair bound ac(S,{2})<=4+d_2 implies d_2>=2, hence
2 is isolated in P1. No P2 isolation of2 is asserted. Strip2
from K={1,2}, which covers P5, only at depth one. Thus {1}
covers P1. Every letter is injective outside1 and has rank at
least12. A nontrivial kernel is exactly one pair {1,q}: a triple
or two nontrivial blocks would collide two inputs outside1.

The mandatory set U={0,2,3,5,6,7} is isolated in P1. Other than
2, its points have stronger previously proved isolation depths.
In particular0,3,5 are isolated in at least P4. The possible
kernel partner is4 or an ordinary point in J={8,...,12}.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g2-exclusion--two-letters-cannot-supply-the-c-targets"></a>
#### Two letters cannot supply the C targets

A letter L with pre_L(0)=C={1,4} exists, so its unique kernel
is14. If every letter kernel were empty or14, the singleton pair
graph edge14 would be backward closed: each letter's pre(C) is
A3,B0,C14 or D5, hence a distinct inverse of edge14 is only14.
All immediate collisions are in that graph, so no other pair is
mergeable. Synchronization would be impossible.

Some letter R therefore has kernel {1,q}, q in J. It differs
from L because a letter cannot have two distinct kernel pairs.
Since the alphabet is binary, L and R are all the letters.

L cannot have pre(C)=C, because C is already pre(B). R cannot
have pre(C)=C either: if R1 belongs to C, then Rq=R1 belongs
to C, so q would also belong to pre(C), a contradiction. Thus
both letters have pre(C) a singleton {u} with u in {0,3,5}.

Strong connectivity requires an incoming transition to1. Choose
ell in {L,R} supplying it, so ell(u)=1 for its protected u.
Output4 is absent. Rank at least12 makes4 the only missing
output, hence q has a predecessor x distinct from u. The protected
pair {u,x} follows ell R to a singleton, since its first images
are1,q. This contradicts P2 isolation of u (indeed u is isolated
in P4). No stronger isolation of2 is used. QED.

The binary premise is essential here: with another letter,
pre(C)=C could supply1 without being the C-merger or the external
kernel letter. No all-alphabet exclusion is claimed.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g2-exclusion--complete-independent-controls"></a>
#### Complete independent controls

All365 earlier sixth field pairs are retained in the kernel
inventory. Full individual letters are enumerated under the derived
singleton P1 cover and U's P1 isolation, including every ordinary
permutation and every external1q kernel. The independent checker
uses quotient-kernel injections instead of the generator's outside1
output assignments. It verifies the two role implications above
on every full letter, the inverse closure of edge14, and every
protected two-step witness for all q in J. These are complete
individual-letter controls of the symbolic proof, not a full n13
transition-pair scan or a bounded-solver negative.

Run enumerate_b1_e6_f7_sixth.py and check_b1_e6_f7_sixth.py with
Python>=3.10 and assertions enabled. This is auxiliary work outside
the unchanged109-file accepted manuscript supplement.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g8-exclusion--the-seven-geometric-possibilities"></a>

[Seventh entrance and mandatory-core cut in E6/F7/G8](#problem4-b1-seventh-entrance) proves common seventh preimages after retaining
and rejecting every uncovered Boolean remainder. Its complete inventory
has H2,H9,H12,H19,H24,H29,H129, with19 labelled choices. Any fresh
singleton is represented by9 after a state permutation fixing the earlier
fibers. Ordinary permutations are not fixed in the row enumeration.

the K12 cover floor. [Four binary paired seventh exclusions in E6/F7/G8](#problem4-b1-e6-f7-g8-paired-seventh-exclusions) and its
two audits exclude H12,H19,H24,H129 for binary. Only H9,H29 remain.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g8-exclusion--exact-finite-row-domain-for-the-remaining-geometries"></a>
#### Exact finite row domain for the remaining geometries

Put Q={0,...,12}, K={1,2}, P={0,3,5,6,7,8}. K covers P5.
The initial S and every actual image through four meet each of

    B={0}, C={1,4}, D={5}, E={6}, F={7}, G={8}, H

once, and contain3. If H9, their family has eight nine-sets, and
P union {9} is mandatory. If H29, the family has twelve nine-sets
and P is mandatory. By [Isolation of the mandatory core at the reaching depth](#problem4-mandatory-core-isolation) the respective
mandatory set is isolated in P7. The images here have cardinality9;
one-count uses actual states, not trajectory multiplicity.

There are128 possible preimage-field rows and1094 parent binary field
pairs per geometry. These are the literal admitted fields in the
independently checked b1_seventh_inventory.json. The manifest copies
every field and pair, including unused field rows. For a field row,
the seven named input groups are the inverse images of the target groups

    {3}, {0}, {1,4}, {5}, {6}, {7}, {8}.

All remaining inputs map to T={2,9,10,11,12}. Thus these eight groups
specify the allowed output sets for every input state. The following
enumeration is exact for all individual rows satisfying the immediate
kernel cover and mandatory isolation:

1. In each group inject all inputs outside K into its allowed target set.
2. Give each input in K every target except those already used by a
   mandatory input. Both guards may use the same target.

Necessity follows because two inputs outside K cannot collide, and no
mandatory input can collide with any different input. Conversely every
assignment in this enumeration has all immediate kernel pairs incident
to K and no immediate kernel touching the mandatory set. A three-state
kernel block containing both guards and one ordinary input is retained.
No rank bound, higher-depth edge-count cap or representative ordinary
permutation is imposed. This is an enlargement if some assignments fail
other equality constraints, which is harmless for a negative proof.

A second enumeration instead assigns an output to each named input in
order0,...,12, rejecting an equality of outputs only when both inputs
are outside K or one input is mandatory. It visits every permitted
literal assignment exactly once. Its sorted raw rows agree byte for byte
with the first enumeration, as bound by a SHA-256 digest.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g8-exclusion--single-letter-cuts-are-necessary"></a>
#### Single-letter cuts are necessary

For each complete row t, discard it if a power t^d merges a pair touching
the mandatory set for d<=7, or an outside-K pair for d<=5. Also require
at least one initial nine-set in the displayed family whose pure powers
through eleven contain3 and retain cardinality9, with the first four
images still in that family. An actual equality model and its actual S
satisfy these conditions for each letter. Thus deleting such a row cannot
delete a target model. Record every initial set that passes; no reaching
word is guessed or assumed.

| H | raw individual rows | rows after necessary cuts | raw field-pair product | remaining pair product |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 9 | 163680 | 39672 | 1696665600 | 91664640 |
| 29 | 117120 | 32856 | 348652800 | 18539136 |

The products are sums over all1094 admitted field pairs. A field pair
with two identical field indices may produce both letter orders; keeping
this duplication enlarges the checked domain. Every possible binary
target occurs in it. Raw and retained individual-row digests and all256
per-field counts are independently checked. The data report stores only
the counts and digests; the full temporary row lists are regenerated.

<a id="problem4-b1-e6-f7-g8-exclusion--complete-coupled-row-negative-certificate"></a>
#### Complete coupled-row negative certificate

The reverse implementation checks every remaining pair of rows. It first
intersects the pure-power initial-set masks, then checks strong connectivity
by forward and reverse reachability from0. It computes global shortest
pair merging distances by starting with immediate kernel pairs and taking
successive original-letter preimages. Reject a protected pair at depth<=7,
an outside-K pair at depth<=5, or a stabilized pair graph missing some pair
(nonsynchronization). The two-row alphabet uses precisely its two original
letters, with each letter costing one. No timeout or bounded failure is
interpreted as nonsynchronization.

Every one of the110203776 retained normalized row pairs is rejected:

| H | incompatible initial masks | not strongly connected | protected short pair | uncovered short pair | not synchronizing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 9 | 15011520 | 68849232 | 2500032 | 2802960 | 2500896 |
| 29 | 3050688 | 13610256 | 463248 | 1144440 | 270504 |

The protected columns sum depths2,3,4 and the uncovered columns depths2,3.
These categories are disjoint because they record the first rejection.
Neither geometry reaches the candidate stage. The implementation contains
additional prefix-safety, full actual-image reachability and exact local
BFS checks for a surviving candidate, but they are not invoked in this
negative certificate. No candidate or F value is inferred from their code.

An independent forward implementation rechecks every retained normalized
row pair with a deliberately different order: strong connectivity by a
13-by13 Boolean transitive closure, pair distances by simultaneous forward
successor relaxation to a genuine fixed point, and initial-mask compatibility
last. It uses scalar forward pair powers for the individual cuts. Its entire
retained-row list, including each initial mask, has the same canonical digest.
Both complete pair scans have zero survivors. Their different rejection
histograms are preserved; equal histograms are not forced when the cut order
differs. Cycle-plus-identity, cycle-plus-constant, and identity-plus-constant
controls guard both strong connectivity and synchronization implementations.
These controls exercise the bare algorithms with the branch-specific short-pair
cuts disabled; both complete geometry scans enable every necessary cut.

The complete finite coverage and necessary cuts prove the two remaining
binary H exclusions. Combining all seven geometric cases excludes binary
E6/F7/G8. Reachability of the original S is not used to create a model;
there are no surviving strongly connected synchronizing row pairs even
before that final requirement could be tested.

X maps {1} union J into T, injectively on J, with at most one

#### The six-column space

A preimage R containing3 is A. Otherwise, if it contained another
point, all images through six would omit that point. Strong
connectivity reaches every state from S within n-|S|=4 letters,
contradicting that omission. The same argument shows that distinct
one-count fibers among B,C,D,E and the outside R are incomparable.

Some preimage F of E is outside A,B,C,D,E. If not, the nonempty
proper union A union B union C union D union E would be backward
closed under every letter, using the four earlier descriptions.
Its complement could not reach it, contrary to strong connectivity.
This union has six states for E6 and seven for E26.

Put O=Q minus A. Equality gives dim V6=7, so its annihilator has
dimension six. Restriction to O is injective on this annihilator:
an annihilating column supported only on3 has zero inner product
with chi_S only if it is zero. Thus its restricted dimension is six.
It contains the columns 1_O,chi_B,chi_C,chi_D,chi_E,chi_F, since
9 chi_X-1 annihilates the trajectories for each one-count X.

The first five columns are independent: B,C,D,E are mutually
disjoint nonempty sets and their complement in O is nonempty.
A Boolean column in their span that meets S once has constant
coefficient zero. Indeed, it is constant on the complement, which
contains at least four points of S. Its four private-cell values are
then zero or one and their sum is one. It is consequently one of
B,C,D,E. Fresh F gives the sixth independent column. Every other
outside preimage of E lies in this six-column span and meets S once.

For E6, incomparability makes F disjoint from the singleton cells
B,D,E. Both C minus F and F minus C are nonempty. The remainder
outside B,C,D,E,F contains at least three S points. For any Boolean
one-count column in the six-column span the constant coefficient is
therefore zero, and its five private-cell coefficients are Boolean
with sum one. Only B,C,D,E,F occur. Thus E6 has a common fifth F.

No general common-fifth conclusion is used for E26. In particular,
when F16 occurs, R24 satisfies chi_R=chi_C+chi_E-chi_F; the reverse
identity holds for F24. F12 instead has the Boolean companion R46.
The latter has two points outside K and cannot be an E-preimage.
These companions are retained before any deterministic exclusion.
