### Adversarial conjecture ledger

Statuses refer to the precise statements below, not to neighboring conjectures.

**FH1 — OPEN general ALL-shortest full-history cost/rank bound.**
For raw rank d including singleton/Q/ALL literal intermediates, the
claim |w|<=(n-1)(d-1) is now PROVED paper when d<=3, and d4/n>=5,
by [Boolean capacity of a shortest full inverse history](#direct-attack-full-history-boolean-capacity). Every other range remains OPEN;
the existential version is a separate weaker statement. Boolean-space
sharpness is not a DFA counterexample. The98648-neighbor negative
pressure archive is EXPLORATORY, not a universal or independently
audited computation. Prior positive-linear-stage dimension conjectures
remain REFUTED and are not restored by this conditional cost bound.

**SK2 — REFUTED, PROVED paper EVERY odd n>=5; state-minimal n5.**
Having just ONE nontrivial letter-kernel block does not make ALL its
pairs stable in an SC DFA. [A single collision fiber does not make the entire kernel stable](#direct-attack-single-fiber-stability-boundary) gives a
binary ranks n-2/n-1 family with one triple fiber, but only the other
letter's double fiber is stable. Minimum rank is2, with exact minimum-
rank-word length n-3 and different minimum-rank kernels. The least
permutation quotient is universal despite nonsynchronization. Thus the
corank-one canonical quotient test cannot be extended unchanged.
ANY-alphabet state-minimality follows from nontrivial unimodal stability
and the <=3-state stable quotient. The known SOME-stable-pair assertion
is unaffected. General Cerny and priority OPEN; no reset counterexample.

**AM1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper infinite SC sync corank<=1 families.**
The single-cycle annular formula does NOT remain true merely by replacing
the unique cycle with the union of all cyclic states and its size. At
order1 the binary Cerny family has M0=0 and Omega=(n-1)(e0-e1), EVERY
n>=3. Two equal nontrivial m-cycles, EVERY m>=2, give nonzero second-cycle
mass outside M0 as well. [The unmodified annular formula fails on multiple clusters](#direct-attack-annular-multicluster-boundary) spells out the
specific extrapolation and its independent integer checks. The original
one-cluster paper lemma is NOT refuted; different multicluster formulas
and general Cerny remain OPEN.

**SK1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper n3, state-minimal for a defect-one kernel.**
Without SC, a defect-one letter kernel need not be stable, and even when
ALL letters have corank<=1 mergeability need not be transitive. The rows
f=(0,0,2),g=(0,2,2) merge01/12 respectively, while02 is a deadlock;
01 g=02. Every n2 defect-one letter is constant, so its kernel is stable
under ANY alphabet. [Stable kernels and the canonical group quotient](#direct-attack-corank-one-stability-quotient) includes the exact
complete monoid check and states the required SC condition. Stable-kernel
existence or iterative quotient rounds alone still give no short-word cost.

**CA1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper infinitely many n=3p, p>=3.**
No universal specified-state compress-with-another bound Cn+C0 can have
C<4/3, even binary SC synchronizing inputs with both letters corank-one.
[Exact specified-state compression in the completed Figure 3 family](#direct-attack-compress-other-exact-lower) proves mu0=4p=4n/3 by ALL-word pair-entry
potentials and complete entrance lists. The prior charged reset stays
under square. This upgrades the source's conjectural threshold and the
previous finite equality. Universal linear upper bounds, exact all-n
ordinary rt, priority and Cerny OPEN; no formal kernel claim.

**PC3 — REFUTED, PROVED paper EVERY n>=3.**
Connectivity of the ORIGINAL forward letter-kernel graph is not necessary
for synchronization, even binary SC with every letter corank-one. The
common-kernel chain in [Forward kernel congruence and terminal merge graphs have different boundaries](#direct-attack-original-kernel-graph-boundary) has just one
forward edge forever, rt=n-1 and exactly two shortest words. Its genuine
kernel-generated congruence has a singular quotient action. Likewise
containing row kernels in an invariant space does not make its quotient
injective. The general forward stagnation/depth/cost lemma remains valid;
the virtual normal-graph theorem is distinct and unaffected.

**T3 — REFUTED at a smaller finite n6; no state-minimum claim.**
The graph of pairs merged by original words of length<=n need not be
connected in an SC synchronizing DFA. A binary rank6/5 witness has state5
isolated through length6, connectivity7 and rt19<25. The existing n9
Figure3 data already refuted this universal n cutoff; the new ordinary
word/set checker supplies a smaller retained witness, not a new general
method obstruction or all-n threshold. See [Forward kernel congruence and terminal merge graphs have different boundaries](#direct-attack-original-kernel-graph-boundary).

**PC1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper EVERY n>=3; state minimum n3.**
Full S_n generated by nearest permutation completions does not imply
synchronization, even for binary SC corank-one inputs. The counterfamily
in [Nearest permutation completions: a general necessary theorem and a sharp failure](#direct-attack-permutation-completion-boundary) has original minimum rank EXACTLY
n-1 at ALL word lengths and exactly three Q-images, yet a completion is
a full n-cycle and original a is an adjacent swap. At n2 every singular
letter resets, so no smaller arbitrary-alphabet failure exists. The
forward necessary implication holds for arbitrary ranks and alphabets.

**PC2 — REFUTED, PROVED paper EVERY n>=3.**
Nearest completion membership in the virtual group does not imply
membership in the original transition monoid, regardless of allowed
word length. BOTH completions in PC1 are absent from that entire monoid:
words containing b are singular; words omitting b give only identity/a.
Neutral compatibility is exact but adaptive, and cannot make completion
actions freely controllable. No reset-length lower bound or Cerny
counterexample follows. Priority OPEN; no formal kernel claim.

**AC3 — REFUTED for every fixed cardinality pair, PROVED paper.**
One cannot strictly improve the known n-|A| avoid-or-compress bound at
ALL state counts solely by fixing ANY 1<=|A|<|S|, binary alphabet, SC,
synchronization and ACTUAL-image S. [Sharp avoid-or-compress examples for every fixed cardinality gap](#direct-attack-avoid-compress-all-gaps) gives
equality for every gap>=3 along n=|A|+k(|S|-|A|-1)+2, k>=2; the first

proof checks ALL original words, and the attaining word has no rank drop.
This does not exclude pointwise improvements at other n or establish a

**AC2 — REFUTED, COMPUTATIONALLY VERIFIED finite n6.**
The proposed avoid-or-compress improvement ac(S,A)<=n-|S|+2 for
|S|-|A|>=2 fails in a binary SC synchronizing DFA, even with ACTUAL S.
[Sharp avoid-or-compress bounds on an infinite part of the third face](#direct-attack-avoid-compress-third-face) retains rows, Q-reaching word and exact
ordinary-set BFS: |S|4, |A|1, ac5>4, rt18<25. Its all-parameter

Adding another anchor to that timer has an early compression and does

**AC1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper on two full cardinality faces.**
The known avoid-or-compress bound n-|A| cannot be strictly improved
solely by imposing |S|=|A|+1, or proper |S|=|A|+2, together with binary
alphabet, strong connectivity, synchronizability, and ACTUAL-image S.
[Sharp avoid-or-compress bounds on the first two cardinality faces](#direct-attack-avoid-compress-sharp-faces) gives equality for EVERY admissible n and
|A| on those faces, with fully charged synchronization certificates.
The Q case has exact maximum1. General gap>=3, priority, and general

**CS1 — REFUTED, PROVED paper on infinitely many simple circular inputs.**
One cannot restrict a general square proof to reset words with total
ORIGINAL-letter corank exactly n-1. [Two neutral singular steps can be unavoidable in a simple circular DFA](#direct-attack-antipodal-corank-slack) gives
SC SIMPLE binary n=2m automata for EVERY odd m>=3. Every reset requires
corank slack>=1 at n6 and>=2 for m>=5: at least TWO singular steps

forces the first stall, and a two-growth return to balanced pairs

**D6 — REFUTED for EVERY positive coefficient/additive error, PROVED all d>=2.**
Even SOME optimized shortest original-word or actual-image history need
not have normalized dimension proportional to proper stage count.
[Every optimal history can have only logarithmic dimension](#direct-attack-all-optimal-log-counter-history) gives n=2^d-1 SC Eulerian inputs,
rt=P=n-1, ONE optimal endpoint chain, n-2 proper stages, exact rankd-1;

Any universal positive-fraction proper-stage dimension guarantee among

**D3 — REFUTED, state-minimal n5 over ANY finite alphabet.**

actual-image histories need not be proportional to the number of proper
growth stages, even for SC Eulerian completely reachable DFAs. For every
d>=3, n=2^d-1, [Logarithmic dimension in genuinely shortest inverse-growth histories](#direct-attack-log-dimension-shortest-extension-history) gives n-2
proper actual stages with EVERY phase e1, raw rank d and normalized rank
d-1. Actual membership, full word cost and Eulerian degrees are separately
proved and checked. The chosen history costs n-1 while rt=P=2. Thus this
refutes an ALL-CHOICES dimension claim; it does not refute a guarantee for
optimized histories or a tradeoff involving long phases. Those are OPEN.
No fixed-alphabet, alphabet-minimality or general square failure claim.

[Maximal shortest jumps do not force linear history dimension](#direct-attack-maximal-jump-log-history) further proves D2 even with ONLY permutation
and unitary original letters and MAXIMAL cardinality among shortest
parent ties. Its selected stages all have e2 and every shortest parent
has one extra point, so the maximal-jump rule cannot remove the chain.
Counting EVERY intermediate single-letter preimage still has raw rank
2log2(n+1)-1 and normalized rank 2log2(n+1)-2. Here n-1<=rt<=P<=2n-3;
this is not a constant-reset construction. Global-optimality and a
long-phase dimension guarantee are not asserted and remain OPEN.

**I28 — REFUTED even with a fixed BINARY alphabet, all-parameter proof.**
The fixed-alphabet qualification does not rescue e(S)<=Cn+d for ANY
fixed C,d. The simple ternary double-cycle/fold family has exact
e(T)=ceil(p(p+4)/2), n=2p+1. Its binary selector encoding preserves
the actual-image family and gives exact e(T')=3(p^2+3p-2)/2+ceil(p/2)+1
on N=6p+3 states, hence N^2/24+O(N). The binary family is SC and
irreducibly synchronizing; N39 already has e82>78. All strict-subset
arrivals and ALL larger actual sources are included. Explicit common
reset words satisfy the squares, and general Cerny/global policy square
remain OPEN. No unrestricted minimum-state or exact-reset claim.
See [Quadratic actual-image extension with fixed ternary and binary alphabets](#direct-attack-fixed-alphabet-quadratic-image-extension). Earlier fixed-alphabet
universal-linear OPEN labels are superseded. I27's original family remains valid.

The subsequent [Direct binary quadratic actual-image extension](#direct-attack-direct-binary-quadratic-image-extension) strengthens
I28 with exact e(T)=(p^2+2p+2-(p mod 2))/2 on n=2p+1 binary states,
without selector overhead. Its canonical n15 has e32>30; an additional
n13 target has e28>26 by separate complete finite BFS. Its paper reset
interval has leading n^2/4 and an explicit upper below the square.
No global binary minimum, exact all-parameter reset threshold or
global policy square failure follows.

**I27 — REFUTED for every fixed linear coefficient/slack, all-parameter proof.**
For arbitrary finite alphabets, actual image-extension need not satisfy
e(S)<=Cn+d with any fixed C,d. The original adjacent swaps of a path on
n=2r states, plus the sole idempotent b(q)=q mod r, give the reachable

a weighted full-preimage potential controls ALL words, including rank

unrestricted minimum-state claim is made. See
[Every universal linear actual-image extension bound fails](#direct-attack-quadratic-image-extension-obstruction). General Cerny and the global
best compatible image-policy square are OPEN. Earlier OPEN labels for
unrestricted linear image extension are superseded by this entry.

in <=3 steps (simple path through the three distinct pairs); thus best greedy
is optimal and the stated pair/phase inequalities hold. The two-state case
has a constant letter. These elementary facts establish state-minimality of
the n=4 failures, beyond the finite binary/ternary enumerations.

K1 is additionally refuted for every fixed m>k>=2 by the generalized family:
n=kmh and exact bridge (m-k)n^2/(km)+n/m. See [Exact quadratic bridge costs for every fixed rank excess](#direct-attack-generalized-bridge-obstruction).

cases), supplemented by exhaustive unary/duplicate-letter checks, without
a counterexample; 20,000 six-state sampled instances also passed. This DOES
NOT prove n=7 minimal. The stronger uniform O(n) K1 variant is refuted by
the paper infinite family, independently of this minimality question.

K2 is tested with u an ACTUAL word, not an arbitrary map added as a letter.
P1 is minimal at three states. E1/E2 are finite refutations of alleged
necessary characterizations; no new classification theorem is claimed.

All search witnesses retain their input automata, shortest words, complete
distance data and independent-check reports under data/. Failures of these
strengthenings are not failures of the Cerny conjecture.
<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--new-harmonic-coefficient-obstruction-2026-09-29"></a>
### New harmonic coefficient obstruction (2026-09-29)

**H2 — REFUTED.** For every reachable k-set in a strongly connected
synchronizing n-state DFA, c(S)<=2n(n-k+1)/(k-1), without rounding.
The protected-point cycle insertion family has k=n-3, c(S)=9, and unbounded
n with gcd(n-11,12)=1. Every eligible n>36 violates the proposal. This
forces a necessary unrounded coefficient C>=9/4. No state-minimality claim
is made. The rounded C=2 proposal remains OPEN: ceil(8n/(n-4))>=9.
Every rounded coefficient C<2 does fail eventually. See
[Protected-point cycle insertion](#direct-attack-cycle-insertion-theorem) and data/cycle_insertion/.

**Q1 — REFUTED, arbitrary-alphabet SC state minimum n=4.** The proposed
additive quotient lift rt(A)<=rt(A/theta)+(b-1)^2, where b is the largest
congruence class, fails for a=[2,3,0,1], b=[1,0,0,0] and classes
{0,1}|{2,3}: rt(A)=3, rt(A/theta)=1, b=2. The valid all-class subset
count gives 1+M(theta)=3. At n<=3 the proposed lift holds for every
strongly connected synchronizing DFA by the singleton-class argument in
[A bounded-fiber quotient lift](#direct-attack-quotient-fiber-lift); all alphabets up to three letters are also scanned.
This is not a counterexample to Cerny's square.

**Q2 — REFUTED, infinitely many states.** Replacing n-h+1 by n-h in
the short first-return alphabet theorem fails for the binary family in
[Short first returns, compression of a block, and a stronger quotient lift](#direct-attack-short-return-quotient-lift), with h2 and every odd n>=5. Every shorter
return acts as a permutation; a constant return first appears at n-h+1.
This also attains the proved whole-class compression bound exactly.
The general-class cutoff statement already fails at its state minimum n3:
a=[2,2,0],b=[1,0,0],C={0,1}, with sole length-one return b and constant
return aa. Here the minimum class has size one. Requiring C to be a
minimum class still fails at its state minimum n4, with
a=[2,3,2,2],b=[1,0,0,1] and classes {0,1}|{2,3}: b and ab are
permutations, aab is constant. Direct SC/reset/return proofs are in
[Short first returns, compression of a block, and a stronger quotient lift](#direct-attack-short-return-quotient-lift); no added 53-corpus certificate is claimed.

**Q3 — REFUTED, state minimum n3.** Arbitrary reachable images need not
have a synchronizing first-return alphabet, even allowing ALL word lengths.
C3 with a=[1,2,0],b=[0,1,0],C=Qb={0,1} has only the identity return b:
a already gives a partial return. The full DFA resets by baab in four
letters. A proper set of size >=2 first exists at n3. This defeats the
attempt to apply the new quotient reduction directly to arbitrary images;
it does not refute e<=2n or Cerny.

**Q4 — REFUTED, infinitely many equal two-class examples.** The
synchronizing return cutoff need not be <=2m-1 without a strongly
connected graph of bijective class edges. For m2,h=2t+1 the
Fine--Wilf color construction in [Short return monoids with bijective transport between equal classes](#direct-attack-bijective-fiber-return-monoid)
requires cutoff h+1=n-h+1. It is a strongly connected synchronizing
binary DFA and the class sizes are equal. Thus equality of class
sizes alone does not give a cutoff depending only on m.

**Q5 — REFUTED, exact finite certificate; no minimum-state claim.**
The strict full-class reset proposal reset_A(C)<(|C|-1)(n-1),
even restricted to |C|>=3, fails at h3,n10. The rows in
[Direct pressure on the stronger full-class reset proposal](#direct-attack-class-reset-pressure) give reset_A(C)=18 and rt(A)=19, checked
on all 35 reachable C-images. The non-strict proposal is OPEN,
and the full reset is far below Cerny's square81.

**T1 — REFUTED as a proposed proof route, all n>=4.** Optimizing the
terminal-wedge window b cannot make the independent rank sum quadratic
on C_n. Its exact pair spectrum is 1,...,binom(n,2), so terminal span
rank is at most b; b1 attains equality and the optimized bound at
every k is precisely binom(n-k+2,2). Its sum remains binom(n+1,3).
Even replacing the wedge allowance by exact terminal-graph capacities
cannot rescue separately valid worst-rank sums: exact R_k on C_n
gives a strict excess over the square for every n>=4 and an
Omega(n^2 log n) barrier. See [Exact barrier to terminal-window and rankwise worst-case budgets](#direct-attack-terminal-window-cerny-barrier).

The natural alternating-tail extension of the h3,n10 full-class equality
also fails: for p>=4, a^(p+3)b already resets that proposed class in
p+4 letters. This refutes that SPECIFIC equality-family proposal; it
does not prove that larger equality certificates are absent. The exact
designated insertion checks are in [Exact weighted returns and larger-cycle class-reset pressure](#direct-attack-weighted-class-reset-pressure).

**A1 — REFUTED as a proposed averaging route, every n>=6.** A transitive
permutation group need not have an exact nonnegative uniform matrix
average J/n supported on original permutation words of length <=n-1.
For adjacent-transposition generators of S_n, total line displacement
is at most twice the word length, whereas the uniform average forces
expected displacement (n^2-1)/3. The exact minimum expected word cost
is (n^2-1)/6, attained by uniformly chosen cyclic shifts with literal
adjacent-transposition words. It exceeds n-1 at every n>=6. A singular
unit embeds this alphabet in a strongly connected synchronizing DFA;
the assertion still concerns permutation-only support. No claim about
singular-word averages, one-state averages, image extension, the square,
exact maximum-support optimum or minimum refutation size follows.
See [Exact uniform permutation averaging can require quadratic word cost](#direct-attack-permutation-averaging-word-cost) and its independent audit.

**T2 — REFUTED, arbitrary-alphabet synchronizing state minimum n4.**
Terminal-pair component stagnation need not persist, and the pairs
merged through original length n-1 need not form a connected graph.
For a=[0,0,3,2], b=[2,0,1,3], the component partition at lengths
two and three is {{0,1,2},{3}}; at length four it becomes connected.
Its full reset threshold is seven, below the square nine. A singular
letter deletes an intermediate vertex of the earlier connecting path;
only the later direct edge has the necessary preimages. The elementary
three-state quotient proof establishes state minimality for arbitrary
alphabets. See [Terminal-pair components can stagnate and then merge](#direct-attack-terminal-kernel-component-stagnation). This does not
refute terminal-wedge ranks or general linear compress-with-another
bounds; the latter remain OPEN.

**W1 — REFUTED, finite n4 certificate; no minimum-state claim.**
Every SC synchronizing n-state DFA need not have a rooted actual word
of length <=n. For a=[0,0,1,3],b=[3,1,3,2], complete evaluation of
31 original words through four gives 22 actions, none rooted. A rooted
word first appears at length five and has height two; rt=7<9.
The same example refutes the one-letter power template: no prefix
letter x and word v of length <=n makes x v^(n-2) reset. All 62
choices are tested, including nonrooted v. This does not refute a more
flexible entered-image or varying-suffix square budget. See
[Short rooted words and a single-letter power template can fail](#direct-attack-short-rooted-word-obstruction) and its separate literal checker.
<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--positive-original-singular-support-does-not-fit-cost-n-even-at-corankone"></a>
### Positive-original singular support does not fit cost n even at corankONE

[A moving-root square from a paid avoidance and a truncated return chain](#direct-attack-moving-root-paid-compensation) proves on paper at EVERY synchronizing
parameter of its original binary rank(n-1)/permutation family that a
full-Q stationary mixture with POSITIVE weight on the ORIGINAL singular
a requires maximum total word cost n+2. Equivalently positive-leading-a
suffix balancing requires cap n+1, not n-1. This restricted stronger
cost-n bridge is REFUTED by an all-word avoidance lower bound and exact
integer attainment. A weaker stationary singular mixture of cost<=n
does exist, but its support fixes r and does not synchronize. The new
claim does not replace or conflate the earlier weaker support metrics.
At coprime parameters a paid compatible square is nonetheless PROVED.
No Cerny counterexample, unrestricted reset lower bound, or growing
linear-coefficient obstruction is asserted. General Cerny remains OPEN.
<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--designated-two-point-moving-root-returns-cannot-ignore-mixed-cosets"></a>
### Designated two-point moving-root returns cannot ignore mixed cosets

[Noncoprime core permutations: a class return, and a mixed-class boundary](#direct-attack-moving-root-coset-permutations) records a SYNC seven-state original
input where the old pool {a b v, a b v b} grows the core set{0,2,4}
by0/1, neverTWO, with costs10/11. Thus the TWO-point return mechanism
without its coset-preservation condition is REFUTED. The exact cheapest
core-staying extension is instead a b a b a, cost5, independently proved
by ALL128 subset Bellman equations. This does not refute proportional
growth, the new conditional coset theorem, or Cerny. The mixed-input
generalization and unrestricted square remain OPEN.

<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--mixed-core-n-extension-cannot-impose-root-exclusion"></a>
### Mixed-core n-extension cannot impose root exclusion

[A precise mixed-core target: truncate proportional growth before the full core](#direct-attack-moving-root-truncated-budget) gives a mixed n10 input and core six-set
with exact minimum positive core-staying extension11. Exact target
sizes7/8/9 cost11/11/15, certified by independent ALL1024 subset Bellman
values. The root-excluded single n-cost extension claim is REFUTED.
A cost11 TWO-growth truncated witness satisfies the proportional budget;
the unrestricted minimum9 includes the root. Neither the proportional
conjecture nor Cerny is refuted. The untruncated local-to-square argument
has an overshoot gap (square+2); this is insufficient reasoning, not a
refutation of the weaker local statement itself.

<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--arbitrary-core-permutations-do-not-preserve-the-fixed-core-n2-metric"></a>
### Arbitrary core permutations do not preserve the fixed-core n+2 metric

[Exact synchronization and singular-letter avoidance in the arbitrary core model](#direct-attack-moving-root-order-two) has exact n5 avoid-r and positive-original-a
stationary maximum cost8, exceeding n+2=7. The broader extension is
REFUTED; the previously proved FIXED-core metric remains intact. A
separate infinite t2 family has minimum avoiding a-countFOUR but exact
minimum original cost with FOUR a's2n, REFUTING a proposed four-a
upper2M+1. Its ordinary avoiding minimum can be much smaller with
more a's (base12 versus30), so neither ordinary avoidance nor Cerny
is refuted by the fixed-count lower bound.

<a id="direct-attack-failed-conjectures--singular-count-optimality-cannot-be-substituted-for-optimal-support-cost"></a>
### Singular-count optimality cannot be substituted for optimal support cost

[A fast reset with a strict singular-count versus word-cost tradeoff](#direct-attack-reflection-core-tradeoff) proves an infinite binary SC family whose
minimum feasible maximum a-count in positive-original-a stationary
support is3. Constraining support to that optimum forces word cost2M,
whereas an unrestricted explicit support costs<=max(9,n)<2M for M>=5.
Thus a count-optimal support need not be word-cost-optimal. Exact
THREE-a avoiding cost2M also differs from ordinary minimum9. This
does not refute a compatible original-word square; in fact actual
reset5M-6 is proved on the same family.

and doubled OUTPUT states. Single-coordinate signs supply the necessity;

singular letter. The word costs remain essential, as in the established

Literature checked on 2026-09-28. This is a source audit of the proof chain,
not a claim that every related publication has been exhausted.

| Mechanism | Established theorem used | Where this attack still loses |
|---|---|---|
| Pin--Frankl compression | c(S)<=binom(n-|S|+2,2) | Summing independent worst phase costs is cubic. A globally compatible choice of phases is absent. |
| Kernel/transversal escape | k-set and k-block partition: escape within n-k+1 | Appending a rank-k word costs its full length; repeated reuse doubles prefix costs. Larger starting sets do not inherit the linear escape. |
| Avoid-or-compress | A proper nonempty part of S can be avoided or S compressed within n-|A| | Avoidance alone may preserve rank. Obtaining useful repetition across later images still costs too much. |
| Singleton-rich rank plateau | At corank r<n/2, singleton fibers enable a splice after a long plateau | It does not constrain the whole low-rank tail. The saved abstract relaxation has a cubic endpoint. |
| Averaging/extension | Weighted dimension growth can force a change in mass | A mass change need not be an unweighted cardinality increase for a general DFA. We have not removed that bias. |
| Multi-subset dimension growth | More initial independent vectors shorten escape | A useful vector may belong to a different current subset. Cardinality growth does not ensure full independence of history vectors. |
| Forward/backward meet | R contained in a singleton preimage T yields a reset word | Complete search is exact; greedy frontiers do not preserve a square guarantee, even with a phase-interior meet. |
| Genealogy/potential | Reset histories give merge trees and Bellman lower certificates | Tree depth alone does not charge transport between subsets. A lower-feasible LP potential proves no upper bound. |

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--direct-primary-sources-and-attribution"></a>
#### Direct primary sources and attribution

**Pin (1978).** [Author-hosted paper](https://www.irif.fr/~jep/PDF/AlgebreLineaire.pdf),
Corollary 4 and Proposition 5, already contains the transversal persistence
assertion and the rank recurrence used here. [Kernel bridge (independent reconstruction of Pin 1978)](#direct-attack-kernel-bridge) is an independent
reconstruction of known theory. It is not a new compression theorem.

**Szykula (2018).** [STACS paper](https://drops.dagstuhl.de/storage/00lipics/lipics-vol096-stacs2018/LIPIcs.STACS.2018.56/LIPIcs.STACS.2018.56.pdf)
provides the avoiding/linear-algebraic route used to identify the splice
bottleneck. We have not strengthened its general avoiding bounds.

**Shitov (2019).** [Primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/html/1901.06542v1)
optimizes the cubic combination, with leading coefficient
7/48+15625/798768, approximately 0.1654. Our rank-profile relaxation retains
the relevant local inequalities but supplies no improved uniform coefficient.

**Berlinkov--Szykula (2016).** [Primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1412.8363)
gives algebraic criteria and stronger useful low-rank consequences than the
elementary repeated-Pin examples in [Necessary conditions, with quantifiers kept explicit](#direct-attack-minimal-counterexample). Those examples
are not new restrictions and are not used to claim improvement.

**Kisielewicz--Kowalski--Szykula (2016).**
[Author-hosted paper](https://kot.rogacz.com/Publications/Kisielewicz2016ExperimentsWith.pdf)
already covers larger binary/ternary verification ranges and discusses greedy
compression and inverse heuristics. Our small enumeration adds independently
checkable profiles for this attack; it is not a new computational verification
record or a new classification of small extremal automata.

**Szykula (2026).** [Current open-problems paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.24245)
still lists the general bound as cubic. Section 2.8 develops multi-subset
dimension growth and poses a history-dimension question. The new logarithmic
dimension savings do not settle the general square bound. Our five-state
dependence example rejects full independence; it does not resolve that broader
question or improve the Eulerian results.

**Kisielewicz--Szykula (2016).** [Primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1608.01268),
Section 3.1, proposes image extension: for reachable S, a short u whose
preimage contains a larger reachable T. It implies a quadratic bound;
their examples force coefficient at least 3/2. Arbitrary-subset extension
has quadratic obstructions, so the reachability condition is essential.
This is a known conjecture, not a newly proposed theorem here.

The exact all-(k,m,h) bridge formula, infinite corank-two and corank-three
padding families, the protected-point cycle insertion construction,
and the particular policy/information
obstructions were reconstructed here. Their priority remains **OPEN**.
Searches did not establish a matching prior statement; absence of a search
hit is not evidence sufficient for a novelty claim. Known circular/one-cluster
results and unreviewed 2026 subclass preprints are not treated as a proof of
the unrestricted conjecture.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--sharpened-open-target"></a>
#### Sharpened open target

**Ferens--Szykula (2025 manuscript revision).**
[Primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/html/2208.05956v5), Lemma 3.2 and
Theorem 5.7, gives union transfer and a quadratic reaching bound when
all sets larger than the target are reachable. This is a known
conditional/class result. [Local rank potential and union transfer](#direct-attack-local-image-potential-obstruction) identifies
the unreachable inverse fiber piece defeating direct capacity transfer.
No completeness hypothesis is removed. The circular policy formula and
finite policy obstructions retain OPEN priority.

The missing statement is a compatibility theorem: choose useful images,
kernel words and prefix/suffix histories together, while charging the FULL
transport and word lengths. It must bypass the prescribed-kernel quadratic
obstruction and permit non-greedy choices. No inequality closing that global
cost at (n-1)^2, or even at o(n^3), has been proved here.

Per-image rank potential, capacity union transfer, singleton averaging
and one-edge singleton policy transport are now separately refuted.
Allowing arbitrary phase lengths makes the recurrence equal the original
exact shortest-word problem and supplies no bound in n.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--alternating-templates-and-nonhereditary-images-2026-09-29-audit"></a>
#### Alternating templates and nonhereditary images (2026-09-29 audit)

The alternating-family proof realizes ordinary Cerny generators on its even
template by the actual ambient words b^2 a and ba. The image characterization
and linear e(S)<=2n result are restricted to this explicitly verified family.
The image-extension framework remains the known Kisielewicz--Szykula route,
not a new general method. The same primary 2016 manuscript also uses
permutation/multiple-cycle constructions for extension obstructions; sharing
that architecture supplies no priority claim for the particular new family.

The proper-image-heredity counterfamily, its four-state unrestricted minimum,
the alternating image structure and the exact conjectured 2n-4 middle-layer
maximum all retain OPEN priority. Primary-source searches have not established
a matching published statement; this is not a completed novelty search.
The finite exact layer formula has not been proved for arbitrary n and does
not establish an asymptotic coefficient >=2 when additive slack is allowed.
<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--completely-reachable-boundary-for-the-new-policy-work"></a>
### Completely reachable boundary for the new policy work

[Ferens--Szykula, current primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2208.05956),
Lemma 5.6, gives a proper onto extension of length at most
ell+n-ceil(n/(n-|S|)) under its reachability hypotheses. Thus on completely
reachable inputs our weaker into-image e is already <2n by known theory.
Searching that class for an e>2n obstruction would repeat a settled bound.
Corollary 6.7 explicitly starts reset construction with a one-letter merged
fiber. This resolves attribution of that step in the new anchored profile;
the actual reachable-capacity profile for incomplete image families has
OPEN priority. Lemma 3.2's union step concerns onto predecessors and does
not transfer to into-image transport, even with complete reachability;
[Complete reachability and modular capacity do not repair union transfer](#direct-attack-complete-union-obstruction) gives an independently checked binary n4 failure.

[Zhu's primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.19089), Proposition 9
and Section 4, already identifies limitations of n-expandability and
disproves Don's completely reachable subset-reaching conjecture. Its
subset-reaching lower bounds are not unrestricted reset lower bounds.
The present native complete-image kernel is an exact policy search tool,
not a new quadratic reset theorem. The shortcut family and its precise
policy lower bound remain priority OPEN; no novelty claim follows from
the small counterexample or the fixed-word construction.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--first-drop-policy-equalities-and-current-literature-recheck"></a>
#### First-drop policy equalities and current literature recheck

On 2026-09-29 the primary 2016 image-extension manuscript was reread at
Sections 3.1 and 4 (especially its Lemma 2 and initial inverse seed family).
One-letter inverse seeds and image extension are established ideas. Its
ordinary seed states are not silently identified with the present actual
reachable-image capacities. [First-drop normal form and exact singleton policy propagation](#direct-attack-first-drop-image-policy) supplies complete
proofs of the exact all-tie boundary/nearest-seed equalities; their priority
remains OPEN, as do the precise largest-seed penalty and inclusion failures.
No exhaustive novelty search is claimed.

The [2026 open-problems primary manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.24245)
was rechecked at Section 2.1: it still records the best known general bound
as approximately 0.1654 n^3+o(n^3), and retains Cerny's square conjecture.
The present normal forms remove unnecessary initial singleton phases but
do not bound compatible future tails. Maximum seed cardinality, inclusion
maximality, antitone G, and arbitrary future ties each fail as stronger
selection rules. Neither these failures nor the finite negative square
searches improve that published general upper bound.

The new global rt=3/P=n family and its same-image single-transition control
have priority OPEN. The elementary e(S)<=ell+n-|S| bound uses a known SC
first-entry walk after an existing reset; its policy rank sum is a direct
deduction, not a claimed new synchronization mechanism. Its conditional
square regime cannot improve Cerny's bound because the hypothesis already
provides a shorter reset. It does guide counterexample mining away from a
settled regime. The specific global approximation obstruction is stronger
than merely restricting to a maximum seed, but does not refute the policy
square target or supply a new n-only upper bound.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--binary-irreducibility-and-approximation-literature"></a>
#### Binary irreducibility and approximation literature

The new [Binary irreducibly synchronizing short-reset policy penalty](#direct-attack-irreducible-short-reset-policy) strengthens the global obstruction
to binary irreducibly synchronizing inputs. This term uses the deletion
definition in [Kisielewicz--Szykula 2016, Section 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1608.01268):
both unary subalphabets are nonsynchronizing. The present exact parameter
family and all-tie image-policy cost have OPEN priority; the known
image-extension route and irreducibility definition are not claimed new.

[Ananichev--Gusev 2016, publisher abstract](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.3233/FI-2016-1357?download=true)
already presents families limiting greedy approximation strategies. On
2026-09-29 the primary abstract was checked; the full text could not be
accessed through the available publisher tools. Consequently the present
actual-image policy is not declared equivalent to or distinct from their
algorithm class. Full-text comparison remains part of the unresolved
priority audit, not a mathematical assumption of the new proof.

[Reset rank trajectories bound every shortest-image seed policy](#direct-attack-reset-rank-profile-budget) is an elementary refinement of transport
after an existing reset: each target rank uses its own remaining reset
suffix. Its rank-area identity is direct double counting. No novel
synchronization mechanism or publication-level novelty is asserted. It
provides a more precise necessary policy-counterexample trajectory but
does not replace the need to prove existence of a short reset. The full
future-tail compatibility and a universal sum of extension losses remain
the general-bound bottlenecks.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--cyclic-tail-unit-class-and-weighted-rank-charging"></a>
#### Cyclic-tail unit class and weighted rank charging

[Don 2015, Proposition 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1507.06070), reread at Section4,
already covers the circular j0 unit-letter subcase: excluded-to-contraction
distance n-h is coprime to n precisely when h is. The present square
construction for that subcase is reconstructed known theory. The full
SC cyclic-tail orbit classification and precise explicit word retain OPEN
priority. No publication-level novelty or exhaustive full-text comparison.

The all-reset-word rank-area barrier reconstructs the classical inverse
interval mechanism on C_n and introduces a precise weighted certificate
obstruction. Its priority remains OPEN; Bellman primal/dual certificates
are standard shortest-path tools. The theorem quantifies the failure
of uniform rank-envelope charging even when a square policy exists;
it is not a new unrestricted reset lower bound or upper improvement.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--single-permutation-unitary-letters-and-positive-averaging"></a>
#### Single permutation, unitary letters and positive averaging

[Szykula--Vorel, DLT 2016, section 3, Proposition 3 and Lemma 5](https://ktiml.mff.cuni.cz/~vorel/bib/VO7conf.pdf)
was read directly on 2026-09-29. Straight shortest words and immediate-unit
greediness are known for ALL PU alphabets. The new insertion proof explicitly
reconstructs that mechanism. With ONE permutation it yields every-target,
every-shortest-parent equality G=W=d(Q,S); two permutations already have
rt6,P7 at n4. Immediate-letter greediness and shortest-WORD phase greediness
are different properties; the saved reset satisfies the former.

[Rystsov 2022, publisher abstract](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10559-022-00428-3)
states the square for trivial/regular groups with simple idempotents. Its
full publisher text is subscription-only. [Rystsov 2025, section 4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.19166)
defines regular as transitive and semiregular and treats a single simple
idempotent with such a group. This does not directly cover unequal disjoint
cycles with arbitrary unit sets. [Ferens--Szykula 2026](https://doi.org/10.1145/3798283)
confirms known PU complete reachability and quadratic class bounds.
Circular/trivial-group conclusions are reconstructed known theory; priority
of the mixed-cycle n-c+1 bound and all-tie equality remains OPEN.

The positive polynomial product_i(1+x+...+x^(l_i-1)) averages every a-cycle
exactly and has degree n-c, even for permutation order 360360. No delayed
unit growth forces cycle means to decrease along a strongly connected unit
quotient, hence all equal; positivity gives zero gradients and a recurrence
propagates them to every conjugate. This closes the square for ONE
permutation and arbitrary units. It supplies neither an unrestricted bound
nor a simultaneous averaging operator for noncommuting generators.

General idempotents expose the actual-image obstruction: a five-state
full-cycle model has unrestricted larger preimage cost5 but actual-image
capacity10. Its sole earlier preimage {0,1,4} is unreachable. Therefore
replacing units by idempotents without a reachability bridge is invalid.
Binary permutation/idempotent covers n2..5 certify the class state minimum;
no minimum across arbitrary alphabets is asserted.

The commuting-permutation repair of exact phase policy also fails: the
saved n6 has rt8,P9 with two commuting permutations and two units. Known
immediate-unit greediness is respected. A shorter route in a commuting
Cayley graph need not occur on the original permutation prefix; the
insertion costs cannot be silently removed. Complete n2..5 covers establish
state minimum6 only for two permutations plus at most three units. A
possible orbit-sensitive extension bound for broader commuting PU alphabets
remains OPEN; this refutation addresses the exact policy bridge only.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--prefix-graphs-and-ordinary-versus-actual-extension"></a>
#### Prefix graphs and ordinary versus actual extension

The exact PU prefix-graph identity ([Polynomial pair graph, exact extension maximum, and an odd-state obstruction](#direct-attack-pu-prefix-extension-theorem)) is a
polynomial ordered-pair computation of max actual e over all nonempty
subsets. It uses known conjugate-unit reachability; priority of this precise
identity and odd-state e=n+1 obstruction remains OPEN. Published PU bounds
already give quadratic synchronization; this is not a new general bound.

[Kisielewicz--Szykula, MFCS2015/arXiv1608.01268](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1608.01268)
was read directly, including Section3.1. Their quadratic ordinary-extension
obstructions have unreachable difficult subsets. Their Image-Extension
Conjecture1 is the same actual-image/capacity formulation used here: the
larger preimage need only contain a larger actual image. It does not require
the entire preimage to be reachable. Hence the known ordinary obstruction
does NOT refute our actual-image e<=2n route. The repository's earlier
coefficient<2 obstructions strengthen their lower constant3/2, with
priority still OPEN. No new universal linear extension result is obtained.

[Gonze--Jungers2018, Proposition2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.02540)
has a quadratic exact-reaching obstruction with no rank n-1 images.
Even then actual e does not equal exact reaching: its only larger image Q
may map STRICTLY INTO the target at a lower rank. [Quadratic exact reaching, linear into-image bypass and linear resets](#direct-attack-rank-skip-image-bypass)
constructs an all-n word of length3(n+1)/4 dropping two ranks twice, and a
reset of length(11n-1)/4, for n>=7,n=3 mod4. The family and the qualitative
bypass observation are published; precise word priority remains OPEN.
This removes a tempting but invalid refutation of universal actual e<=2n.

[Zhu, FSTTCS 2024](https://drops.dagstuhl.de/storage/00lipics/lipics-vol323-fsttcs2024/LIPIcs.FSTTCS.2024.34/LIPIcs.FSTTCS.2024.34.pdf)
proves that a synchronizing automaton whose permutation letters generate a
transitive group and whose other letters all have rank n-1 has reset
threshold at most 2n^2-7n+7. Its Rystsov-graph growth argument gives
ordinary extension within 2n-3. This is a quadratic special-class bound,
not the unrestricted square. It is a relevant published comparator for our
PU prefix graph; no novelty or general-bound inference is drawn from that
similarity.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--congruence-lifting-and-the-simple-automaton-bottleneck"></a>
#### Congruence lifting and the simple-automaton bottleneck

[Rodaro--Venturi (2026), Proposition 3.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.17992)
proves the square lifts from a quotient of a strongly connected automaton
whenever that congruence has a class of size one or two. Their general
hereditariness problem remains open. Their 7/48 cubic coefficient is
conditional on a quotient already satisfying the square, not an improved
general cubic bound. [A bounded-fiber quotient lift](#direct-attack-quotient-fiber-lift) adds an elementary conditional
count of all non-singleton subsets inside congruence classes. It excludes
profiles with every class size 3..6. A rank-truncated variant independently
reconstructs the published 1/2-class qualitative lift. Together these say
that a hypothetical state-minimal counterexample may have a nontrivial
congruence only if one class has size at least seven. Simple automata have
no such congruence, so this does not resolve the hard general case. The
precise counting lemma's publication priority has not been established.
For at least three quotient states, the same count raises that necessary
class size to eight.
The truncated bound additionally handles the two-class (3,7) profile,
which the full-subset count alone leaves open. The pair-truncated variant
also handles (4,7) and shows that any hypothetical minimal-counterexample
congruence has EVERY class of size at least four. No conclusion about all
seven-state-class profiles follows. Priority of these precise bounds is
unsettled; they are not an unrestricted synchronization bound.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--terminal-kernels-and-the-exact-one-kernel-barrier"></a>
#### Terminal kernels and the exact one-kernel barrier

The exterior-space proof in [Terminal kernels refine Frankl compression at every rank](#direct-attack-terminal-kernel-frankl) refines the
established skew set-pair argument by removing the entire span of
short terminal pairs. [Frankl 1982](https://doi.org/10.1016/0195-6698(82)90003-4)
is the underlying set-pair source. Priority of this precise terminal
formulation is OPEN; the proof is recorded without a novelty claim.
Its renewing-sequence parameter is exactly the number of edges
outside a smallest weakly saturated subgraph. The complete-partite
construction is established weak-saturation theory; see
[Bulavka--Tancer--Tyomkyn 2023](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00493-023-00049-0),
Corollary 1.2 for the k-partite case. Our elementary coarsening
argument reconstructs the formula for r>=k parts.

Consequently a single letter kernel already attains the whole
terminal-wedge allowance in the set-pair relaxation. Additional
savings need unions of short-word kernels or constraints on actual
word trajectories. The successive-rank compatibility gap remains
when these compression budgets are summed. This is why the new
profile exclusions do not constitute a general square proof.

[Short return monoids with bijective transport between equal classes](#direct-attack-bijective-fiber-return-monoid) generates the ENTIRE return monoid
under bijective transport, a stronger conclusion than a synchronizing
short-return basis. It does not erase path costs: actual generating
returns have length <=2m-1, while permutation inverses may require
powers in that generating monoid. Without the transport hypothesis
the cutoff cannot be bounded using m alone, even with m=2.
The general hereditariness problem and simple-automaton bottleneck
therefore remain OPEN.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--independent-continuation-and-a-quantified-compatibility-barrier"></a>
#### Independent continuation and a quantified compatibility barrier

[Independent return-monoid audit and local-rank continuation](#direct-attack-return-monoid-independent-audit) proves an exact confined-return
alphabet for every bijective-edge SCC and a charged arbitrary local-word
profile bound. The local-rank<=3 square lift applies to nonuniform
profiles as well, and its uniform rank threshold improves to 2m+1.
These are restrictions on class actions even when full-DFA letters
have high rank; priority is OPEN. They leave large local ranks and
simple automata unresolved. Low-rank-word methods are established
literature, including the Berlinkov--Szykula source already recorded;
the finite checks do not establish novelty.

[Exact barrier to terminal-window and rankwise worst-case budgets](#direct-attack-terminal-window-cerny-barrier) gives a concrete all-n test of the
new refinement: on C_n, one new pair becomes terminal at each length,
so optimizing b cannot improve its wedge budget at any rank. Exact
reachable-image rank maxima are floor(n/k)[n-k+(n mod k)+1]. Their
sum exceeds the square at every n>=4 and grows Omega(n^2 log n).
Thus even an exact universal rankwise compression oracle lacks the
compatibility needed for a square proof. This is a reconstruction
and a method barrier, with an independent second proof audit.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--uniform-permutation-averaging-and-original-word-costs"></a>
#### Uniform permutation averaging and original word costs

The displacement statistic in [Exact uniform permutation averaging can require quadratic word cost](#direct-attack-permutation-averaging-word-cost) is the
classical Spearman footrule. [Diaconis--Graham 1977](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1977.tb01624.x)
relates it to inversion distance; our original-letter lower bound is
proved directly, without a novelty claim. For adjacent-transposition
generators of S_n, an exact nonnegative simultaneous average J/n has
minimum EXPECTED cost (n^2-1)/6. Uniform cyclic shifts attain it.
This contradicts the proposed support cutoff n-1 at every n>=6 even
though the group is transitive. A short one-state transversal does not
give that simultaneous average. Signed, singular-word, target-dependent
and weaker stationary averages are not covered by the obstruction.
Group membership cannot replace charged actual-word transport. Thus
this direct extension of the short cycle average is closed; a general
proof still needs a compatible mechanism acting on the current image.
Priority of the precise averaging formulation remains OPEN.

<a id="direct-attack-literature-and-bottlenecks--a-published-conjectural-family-and-a-compatible-rooted-word"></a>
#### A published conjectural family and a compatible rooted word

[Szykula 2026, Figure 3/Conjecture 8](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.24245v1)
leaves a particular family's synchronization and specified-state lower
threshold unproved. [A charged reset construction for the published compress-with-another family](#direct-attack-published-compress-other-family) supplies a charged
arbitrary-parameter reset witness for the diagram-completed family,
and an upper-bound word for its specified state. Its all-parameter
lower threshold is now PROVED (paper) in [Exact specified-state compression in the completed Figure 3 family](#direct-attack-compress-other-exact-lower):
mu0=4p=4n/3 for EVERY p>=3 in these precise diagram-completed rows. The omitted transition-table cases
and the displayed word's extra letter are explicitly documented.
The proof does not borrow an unproved synchronization hypothesis.

The reusable algebra concerns an actual cycle and a reflected adjacent
unit on an actual image. Their composite is rooted, except for a phase
which has an actual-word repair. This directly supplies compatible
transport, with rotation/reflection costs and tree height paid. The
general missing step is to find sufficiently inexpensive analogous
words in arbitrary automata. No priority claim for this elementary
normal form or improvement to an unrestricted bound is made.

The terminal-component stagnation shortcut is separately refuted at
four states. The missing preimage of a path's intermediate vertex is
the precise obstruction to extending permutation-only component
arguments to arbitrary singular letters.

After the positive family theorem, the proposed general short-rooted
word and one-letter power templates were actively tested and refuted.
[Short rooted words and a single-letter power template can fail](#direct-attack-short-rooted-word-obstruction) supplies an exact SC n4 example with
rt7, minimum rooted-word length5, and no `x v^(n-2)` reset with x one
letter and |v|<=n. This separates the existence of a synchronizing
semigroup from the cheap common-word structure used in the family.
The remaining general task still concerns fully charged compatible
prefixes and actions; this new method obstruction is not a Cerny
counterexample or a publication-priority claim.

and the cyclic unit extension mechanism attributed in

did not establish priority of this exact construction/cost combination;
no novelty claim is made. General Cerny and a compatible extension of
this particular proof to noncoprime parameters remain OPEN here.
